tei:div.tei:p: bza' btung ni/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pa yis bza'/ /

zhing btung*/ ro yi gos| dkris ma'i gos bzang dang*/ / rgyan ro bsregs thal bas rnam par brgyan/ / dur khrod phru chag thogs nas ni/ /zer phru chag 1thod pa/2snod du bza' shin tu dman pa'i 'gro ba la/ gsang bar ni/ / nyin mo rang gi rigs dang mthun pa mtshan spyod pa'i dus/ mo'i dus su mtshan dus gsang ste rgyu bar bya zer/ /rgya dpe la/ rgyu bar bya/ / de'i gnas mdor bstan pa/ bzhi mdo dang ni ri bo dang*/ /shing gcig gam ni dur khrod du/ / ni/ gnas bzhir ni de nas spyod pa byed pa de'i dbang gis/ snga gas pa yis/ /bsgom pa de kho na nyid bzang po bya bar brjod/ / ma mo'i khyim dang dus/ mtshan mo rgyu ba'i gnas/ dang*/ /yang na dben pa'am bas mthar ni/ / gang zag cung zad drod ni thob pa yis/ /gal te spyod pa byed par/ 'dod na | | de rten gyi gang zag bdag nyid gal te 'grub 'dod pas/ / snang la zhen me du dwogs pa med par byis pa bzhin du yang ni spyad/ / mdor bstan/ spyod pa'i sgo nas/ sems rgyas par bshad 3dgos pa/ can rjes su bzung ba'i rgyur/ /blo ldan chen pos yul/ rgyu bar bya/ / rgyas bshad la gnyis las/ sgrub pa po drod kyi phyir tsaṇ+ḍā lī bsgom pa ste tsaṇ+ḍā lī bcu gcig pa yang bstan te/ sprul 'khor gyi lam la gtum po spros te tsakra gong ma'i yig 'bru rnams bsregs pa'am yang na yas 'bab kyi byang sems dang mas sbar gyi dus rtogs pa zhen med do/ / zhen 'dzin pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ / zer| pa med pa'i sems yas phab la rtog pa med/ ba spu'i kha zhes bya ba gsung*/ kyis ni/ kha war+ṇa| dog yi ge ste yul la dus bi ka'o/ /bskyur ba'i ras rnying bgo zer can gyi rtog pa la/ rtag sgrib tsaṇ+ḍā lī bcu gcig pa bzhi la brten pa/ bya/ / 1des mngon du byas pa'i ye shes des rtog pa 2bgo bar 3nir ma 4rlung bskum nas sum mdo'i me sbar te ba spu'i khung bu'i brkyang ma nas/

rtsa bug ro ma nas me sbar/ nir/ nas/ / ro ma'i mes ta thā spyan drangs nas rkyang ma nas/ ta thā'i thugs kar 'od zer zhugs pa'am| ta thā'i bdud rtsi bkug pa gnyis ka la gsung phyogs bcu rnams nas nir mar/ su byung bar bya/ / rtog pa'i rtsub pa 'jam pa'i rtsa/rtog pas mi phyed pa'i/ rdo rjer rang mi rtog par/ gyur nas | | snying po dkyil 'khor 'dus/ par ni rab tu brtag / gnas gang du bsgom pa phan yon dang bcas pa pad+ma'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar/ /chu bo 'dus pa rnams su yang*// der gnas nas rang byin rlabs/ rnal 'byor pas bsgom na/ / drod kyi dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /phug gam ri yi rtse mor ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas gnas | | ched du gtad pa med par ji rgyas bshad gnyis las gnyis pa spyod pa dngos/ ltar rnyed pa de bzhin bza'/ /zos shing zos nas lhag ma'i/ gtor ma sbyin/ / ru raka sha sogs shing gi 'bras bu sna tshogs do shal du bya/ sogs/ / rgyan gyi khyad par 'ol ma zi sogs de bzhin spos/ /srog chags yan lag stag gi lpags pa/ gos gyon gnyis spang gi rtags/ zhing | | phyag rgya bde don gnyer la snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgo nas/ bde ba sbyin/ /res 'ga' legs sbyar gyi skad res 'ga'/ zur chag gi sgra/ nyid/ / res 'ga' phyin ci log tu bzlog pa yis ni 'dod par byed/ /bza' dang bza' min ci rnyed pa/ /smyon pa ltar 'chos/ pa'i sbyor bas bza' bar bya/ / rang mi dbang ba gzhan spyod pa'i gnas/ pa'i rang gi min pa lha'i bu mo la sogs pa/ yul 'khor grub pa thob pa'i gnas bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ dang | | ri yi phug dang tshang tshing dang*/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod che/ na po brgyad sogs/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du yang*/ /der gnas shes rab can gyis bsgom | | skrag pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ / ku na bzang gsang nas bsgrub pa la sogs pa de ltar kun 'dar gyi spyod pa gsang ba'i tshul gyis/

byas nas rnal 'byor pas/ /yang ni bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa gnyis kyi mi mthun pa'i/ phyogs kun 'dar gyi spyod pa rang gi sems kyi brtan g.yo brtag pa'i rjes la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bsten pas rgyud la bde ba chen po bskyed pa'i phyir spyod pa gnyis pa bya/ las rnam rgyal brtsams/ / pas ting nge 'dzin skye bas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgrib pa rgod 'gyod| gnyis rmugs/ 'dod la 'dun/ gnod sems sgrib pa kun la rnam par grol/ / phyogs bcur rnam par gnas pa yin/ / sems can gyi/ skye ba'i sgrib pas bsgribs pa yis/ / sems can kun gyi bsam pa yongs su 'gengs/ / shing tshim par byed/ gnyis pa nges tshig gzung mi mnyam pa'i/ ba dang ni 'dzin pa kun/ / de kho na nyid bsgoms pas mngon gyur/ spangs shing bag la nyal/ rnam par spangs/ /'dis ni de kho na nyid/ bsgom pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ thams cad kyi/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal mngon par brjod/ /de ltar phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba la/ re zhig gnas byas nas/ /de kho na/ nyid kyi rtogs pa brtan pa/ ma gshigs rnal 'byor pas/ / rigs gang la brten nas bsgrub pa phan yon dang bcas pa rig pa'i lha mo dang*/ 'dod pa yi/ / las kyi dang*/ dam tshig gi de las 'di dam tshig gi gsung na/ spyir spyod pa'i grogs la bzhi yod pa las 'dir nus pas bkug pa'o/ / shin tu gzugs can de dbang du / bsdus nas gyis/ /chus byung dbyangs can legs pa'i sogs/ yid 'ong rin chen de la brten nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa/ dang*/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo| nyams dga' ma/ /lha yi bu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /yang na klu mo rkang 'og tu// gnas pa dang ni lha min mo/ /'di yang yo gis rig ma gcig /rang gi sems la mngon 'dod pa/ / de'i ting nge 'dzin ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag nas 'gyel nas lcags kyu snying*/ zhags pa'i mgrin/ rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bkug nas bsgrub

| | ci 'dod kyi man ngag gzhug nye bar dgos pa rgyas pa kun/ /ma blangs cha bslangs ja par yang lha yis ster/ / bcud len du 'gyur bas na rga grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas/ dang nad las rnam par grol/ / sbyor bas gnyis su/ med par snyoms par zhugs pas/ gnas gsum sdig pa lus ngag yid gsum du zhen pa'i rtog pa/ med/ / 'a jig rten pa'i mngon du bsgrub pa la kun 'dar gyi spyod pa ji ltar bsgrub pa lus kyi sbyin pa spyod pa'i sngon du sems can thams cad la nga'i lus sbyin no zhes dam bca'/ byin nas ni/ /phyis ni spyod pa yang dag brtsam/ / der lus slong ba 'ong na skal dang skal min rnam dpyad pas/ / pha rol gyi shags rdugs su bcug pas de phyir dngos su lus/ sbyin pa sbyin mi bya/ /bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba nyid/ /ji ltar rnyed pa bza' bar bya/ / ched du gtad pa med/ 'di yid du| 'ong bas bsten/ 'di mi 'ong bas mi bsten zhes pa'i/ rnam rtog phyir/ /zhen pa tsam du mi bya'o | | bslab bya min pa gsum/ dang dbang du bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa gnyis/ las rnam par grol | | de bzhin ngo tsha'i spang*/ bya ba nyid/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de kho na nyid| gyi/ / de kho nar yo gis rnam dpyad snying rje che/ zhes bos/ / mchod sbyin sbyin bsreg dka' thub 'das/ sngags dang bsam gtan rnam par zhen pa med par/ spangs/ / dam tshig sdom par zhen pa/ las rnam par grol/ / de kho na'i shin tu rnal 'byor ldan spyod kyis/ /nges par sngon du lha min gang*/ /brgya byin lta bu yin na yang*/ /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /seng ge'i gzugs kyis rnam par rgyu/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu snying rjes btung bar bya/ / de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor gyi/ btung ba la/ dga' ba'i/ rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhan gyi btung bas bzi ba med/ / chos kyi yang ni thun mong du bsgrub pa la lnga las rgyan la sogs pa/

dpal ldan thabs shes rab phyag rgya chen po'i/ rgyal tshab che/ / 'jig rten pa'i mngon du/ brtul zhugs spyod pa bsgrags par yang | | rnal 'byor pa gang gis dngos grub thob pa'i grogs dang gnas su/ mthar 'gro ba// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / spyod pa byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa sgom pa po yis rnam bzung ba/ /rna ba dag la rna cha bzang*/ /spyi bor 'khor lo rnam par 'dzin/ /lag pa dag la lag gdub nyid/ /rked pa la yang ska rags nyid/ rkang par de bzhin rkang gdub bo/ /dpung pa'i rtsa bar dpung rgyan nyid/ /mgrin pa la ni nor bu ste// bgo ba stag gi lpags pa nyid/ /bza' ba mi 'chi bcu phyed de/ / bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka la sbyar he ru ka sbyor skyes bu nyid/ /mnyam par bzhag pas gnas par bya/ / gnyis pa spyod pa'i grogs shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma/ / kye'i rdo rjer rang gis dbang bskur snying rje can/ /rdo rje'i bu mo g.yung mo/ 'di khyer nas/ /spyod pa brtul zhugs rtogs par bya/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos med na/ / de ma yin pa byin po bzhi pos gang zhig rigs kyi rnam snang yin na bram ze mo lta bu/ 'dod pa'i lha'i/ /rigs kyis kyang ni bya ba'o/ / rigs mthun pa ma rnyed na yang na gzhan gyi rigs byung ba/ /byang chub sa bon byang sems slob ma'i lce la/ bcug pa yis/ / ngag gi dri ma sbyangs pa byas te khyer nas ni | | 1chang yang btung 2gsum pa de mnyes par byed pa'i thabs 3de lta bu khyer nas spyod pa byed pas gang tshe rdo rje gnyis med ye shes kyi rtogs pa/ mchog ldan par/ /de tshe glu ni blangs par bya | | glu yi gang tshe dga' ba skyes pa na/ /thar pa thob/ pa'i rgyur ni gar byas te/ /de tshe rdo rje rkang pas gar/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa yis bya/ / 1bzhi pa rgyan la sogs pa rang gi ngo bo dgos pa dang bcas pa 2 smod tshig mi nyan pa sogs 3gong gi rgyan gyi dag pa 'khor lo'i gzugs kyis mi bskyod pa/

/rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ / ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ / rnam thar sgo gsum shes rab kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gzugs can/ /thabs kyi gzugs kyis cang te'u/ / rtug pa sman ni rnam par bza' ba nyid/ / dri chu ni rtag tu btung ba ste/ /rga shis zil gyis mi gnon cing*/ / gdon bgegs las kun tu bsrung bar gyur pa de'i/ /rkun ma'i skras byas cod pan can/ /de la rang gi skra la rkun ma'i skra'i skud pa byas pa'i spyi bor bcing pa/ hūm̐ byung sbyar bar bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi thod pa rnams | | rnal 'byor pa/ spyod pa byed/ pas rnam par bris sku/ 'dzin/ / thod pa sor lnga'i dum bur byas nas ni/ /cod pan la ni rnam par 'dzin/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ / ro'i skra yi ska rags nyis bskor nyid/ / lus thams cad la thal ba skra yi mchod phyir thogs/ / rdor dril dang*/ po sti bris sku sogs rnal 'byor pa yi spyod pas 'dzin/ /cang te'u'i sgra ni bzlas pa ste/ /sems can thams cad mgron gnyer ba'o/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni shes rab ste/ / gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang rdo rje bzlas dang bsgom pa yin/ / lnga pa spyod pa'i dam tshig bstan pa thod pa can he ru ka du bde ldan| rang gyur pa/ / 1spyod pa byed pa'i dus 2kha zas la/3phung po lngar zhen pa/ rkam pa la sogs pa byung ba'i dus su bsdus la byis pa'i rtse ba ste bsgrub pa skyar/ dang de kho na nyid ma rtogs pas/ rmongs dang de bzhin 'jigs/ nyam nga dang bag tsha/ khro dang ngo tsha'i bya ba ni/ /rtag tu rnam par spang bar bya/ / rim pa gnyis ka'i don he ru ka bdag rnal 'byor pa/ / rgyal rigs la sogs pa rigs lnga la ni gnas par bya/ / bram ze mo la sogs pa rigs lnga dang ni mnyam ldan par/ / g.yung mo rigs gcig tu ni rnam par brtag / spyod pa byed tsam na g.yung mo rigs rigs kyi bdag po du mar 'dug pas/

gcig du ma nyid kyis ni/ / g.yung mo gcig pu gang phyir rdo rje rigs du ma dbye ba bskyed mi bya/ /bdag nyid kyis ni des mtshon nas sgrib pa lnga ka dag gnyid spangs nas/ / spyod pa 'di lta bu bya rung ngam mi rung the tshom med par spyod pa bya/ / dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba las mtha' gnyis la ming btags/ brtag pa'i rgyal po lnga pa'o// //༈ bde mchog gnyis ka'i gleng gzhi'i tshig dang po'i gsum pa dang*/ rgyud phyi mas mthar thug tu bshad cing*/ 'dir ni sbas pa rang byin rlabs dang sbyar te gsal bar byed do/ /ḍā ki'i le'u zhe gnyis par yi ge bcu drug gi byang sems 'phel ba'i rgyu bcud len du bshad pa de'ang khams bcu drug du mar bshad kyang 'dir rang byin rlabs dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas lte bar khams dwangs ma bco lnga 'dus pa zhes bya ba byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor la bshad/ rkan du la sogs pas longs spyod kyi dkyil 'khor gyi yi ge lnga bstan pas kha zas la longs spyod pas lus la phan 'dogs shing nad 'byung ba bzhi bskyed pas lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ yang lus kyi gnas lugs la tshigs chen bcu gnyis la nad 'du ba bzhi bskyed pa'i yi ge bcu drug gnas kyang gsal bar bstan to/ /mdor na yi ge bcu drug gi byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor bstan to/ /sngags bzlas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gnyis po byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa mdor bsdus nas ston pa yin te/ mdor na si h+la dang ga pur la cung zad phye na bdud rtsi lnga'i nus mthu la 'phros nas pha'i rus pa/ rkang*/ khu ba/ gsum/ ma'i gsum pags pa/ shakhrag ces kyang bstan pa yin no// sku'i dgu/ rlung bzhi/ gsung bzhi/ 'byung chung gi thugs gnyis steng sgo la sogs pas mngon du byed pa'i rlung bstan te/ de la rlung gi sgo gang yin pa/ rlung nyid gang yin pa/ rims kyi rgyu sogs bzhi/ tshad tsam/ ming gi rnam grangs so

tshul ji ltar 'gro 'ongs byed pa/ de'i dgos pa rgyud gnyis su kha bskang la ye shes rdo rje kun las btus par ming gi rnam grangs sgra ji bzhin par tshul mi 'dra la/ 'gro 'ong gi tshul dang gnas la sogs pa ma gsungs pa kha bskang bar byed do/ /de ltar byang sems dang rlung bstan pa de'ang lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor phra rags yin pas phyogs gcig tu rtogs par bya ba yin la/ zhu ba rang rgyud pa yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi lam dang sbyar ba kha bskang*| ḍā kar cha mthun/ rdo rje 'dzin pa zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod pas lha lags nyan par 'tshal lags na/ / gsang ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dgongs pa dang rang byin gyis brlabs pa ji ltar 'gyur ba'i gzigs mo lha lags nyan par 'tshal zer ro/ rang gi rang phyag rgya la ma brten par bde ba chen po skye ba'i/ byin rtsa ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i/

brlabs pa'i rim ci lags/ / sbas pa'i yi ge bcu drug gi gsang brtag pa dang po'i gsum pa dang*/ dang po dngos nas gsungs pa'i/ ba la sogs dgos pa ci/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas nyon | | rgyud kun tu ni gtan phab pa/ zer thams snying po/ cad rgyud kyis don/ gtan la/ phab pa | | ni rang byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa'i don/ mdor bsdus pas ni 'dir yi ge'i don gyis| bsgrag par bya/ / skye ba'i gnas gtso bo don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems mngon du byed pa sprul pa'i 'khor lo bstan/ e ni nam mkha' gru gsum/ yi rnam pa gang gsungs pa/ / de nyid gnas kyi mtshan yin/ nyid lte ba'i nam mkha' de gdams ngag med pas rtogs par dka'/ mi gsal bar | | de la brten pa'i ye shes rtogs dka'/ de gang gis mngon du byed snyam pa la 'gro ro ma nas e'i me gyen la/ dang rjes su brkyang ma nas byang sems thur la/ 'ong ba nyid/ / lte bar 'dab brgyad la/ ra s+ye la sogs pa bcu drug gi bkod nas srog gi gnas gnas te de rnams la bstim nas gnon phyir 'byung tsam na yar snying khar 'ong rtsol ba sdud de gtum mo bcu gnyis pa yang bstan/ gang zhig mngon du byed na khams su/ lus kyi khams bcu drug dang ro rkyang nas 'gro 'ong byed pa'i rlung*/ sems su/ kyi sgo gnyis nas/ rtag tu| 'gro 'du/ ba'o/ / bcu gnyis so/ /yang ni lha mo khams kyi sgra khams zhes bya ba'i sgra sa brjod bya ngo bo'i grangs/ du lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / yi ge bcu drug gi bdag nyid dang tha mi dad pa'i bde ba chen po mngon du byed pa bstan 'di grangs kyi lan/ ltar gsang ba'i ni khams bcu drug yi ge bcu drug gi khams bcu drug brjod par bya ste/ / ngo bo'i lan ra ḍā ki bzhi bcu pa nas/ yi rnam pa rak+ta khrag rjes su chags pa'i bde ba/ gi khams/ / ha ya ste 'gro mgyogs ha rlung*/

ni de bzhin klad rgyas/ reg bya rlung gi khams kyi/ dag / shu kra s+ye ni sha'i dwangs ma/ lus kyi dwangs ma/ bad kan zhes byar gsungs/ / dri'i 'dab ma ste zer/ sa ni pags pa nyid du gsungs/ /zer sa snying kha dbyibs mthun/ yi rnam pa sems kyi rten yin pas/ 1kyi dwangs ma|yi ge sa ni mkhris pa nyid lo nyid dang*/ / ra ni dri chen gsungs pa ste/ zer ra yi rnam pas drug gi dwangs ma/ ro rang bzhin rgyu'i ngo bo yin lo/ nyid do/ / mes me ni de me tog rang byung*/ nyid yin/ bzhin ltau tshil dag / bskyed pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma/ ra go ni de bzhin dri chu yin no zer/ me nyid du ni gsungs/ / drod bskyed pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma/ me maṃ sa/ yi rnam pa sha chen/ ru gsungs// tsa tur sa ma/ sa ni dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'o zer/ yi rnam pa bshang bar gsungs/ / sarban rba gdan| yi rnam pa mgon por zhag zer/ gsung zer/ sa de bzhin sgra'i mar/ tshil/ / rba ni de bzhin zhag yin lo/ 1bskyed pa'i khams/ tam pa t+ma me rkang*/ ni ru las skyes lha mo/ ni pags pa bskyed pa'i dwangs ma/ nyid du gsungs/ /ni raṃ su/ yi rnam dri'i mar khu ste dri chen brdung ba'i mar/ pa'ang rus pa nyid/ / bskyed pa'i/ ka pu ri sa ni gci ba nyid du 'gyur zer/ yi rnam pas gci so dang lag skyes sen mo/ so zer/ ba yin/ /nga ni rgya dri chu'i tsha dang ba spu'i tsha*/ mtsho las skyes pa'o/ /zer/ yi rnam pas glo bskyed pa'am ba 'i gsher ba/ ra bcas/ / s+thi ra zhes bya ba gnas pa ste 'dir gnas pa'o 2s+thi ni gang gang zhes bshad pa'i/ /mkhal ma'i rdzas ni rab mdzes ma'o/ /lo s+thi s+thi ni pad+ma nyid gsungs te/ / rdzas dang ldan pas mdzes pa yin/ /zer/ ri pad+ma 'i khu ba/ nyid du gsungs/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i tha mal tsam na lus bskyed/ lam du byas na ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa/ rdzas de ltar bcu drug po bsdu na mi 'chi lngar gnas pas/ dang ldan/ / tsaṇ+ḍā lī bcu gnyis pa yang bstan/

ta na di ti/ yi rnam pas skyes pa'i khu ba ni/ / de thams cad kyang bsdu na khu ba kun rdzob byang sems yin pas byang chub sems las byung ba yin/ / 1de'i gnas 2rtsa bcu drug ā li bcu drug 'pho ba bcu drug nang ltar 3aṃ shad lta bu rtsa yi sgra yi rang bzhin las/ /de ltar lha mo bsgrags pa yin/ / kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rang bde ba chen po dang tha mi dad/ bzhin las/ / ā li ste bde ba| cha yi kā li ste thig le/ bdag nyid 'gyur ba nyid/ / bcu gnyis pa yang bstan/ bcu gsum pa ste chos 'khor du hūm̐/ 'dab bzhir ra sa ma e de la hūm̐ bstim/ bsgom pa'o ra ni me 'i sa bon yin pas| zhes bya bar gsungs/ / me shas che bas/ ra rak+ta khrag shas che bas shas che ba las dang zer| mkhris pa yang dag de ltar ras khrag mkhris gnyis gcig tu/ langs/ / 'byung zer/ s+ye'i 'greng bu e ni e ka ste rlung mkhris bad kan gsum mtshan nyid gcig pa ste 'dus pa'i nad la bya mtshan nyid gsum 'dus pas/ gcig 'dod bad kan sa dngos skye/ las/ /rngul sa'i ya stas rlung bstan te de las/ dang rngul ni rlung las yang dag byung*/ zer/ chu rgyus yang dag byung*/ / rngul dang chu rgyud rgyu ru de yi de dag gtso bo rlung yin te/ zer/ mgon por brjod pa'i rlung*/ / 'gro mgyogs te rlung bstan ha ya/ ni bzhi po de lnga po thams cad la khyab par bstan/ kun tu 'gro bar gsungs// gang la khyab ce na rus pa'i mtshams tshigs zer/ ni lag gnyis rkang gnyis kyi tshigs bcu gnyis po/ 'di rnams su/ / ra ha sa ya e sa nad gzhi lnga'i/ bon lnga ni ra ha sa me rbaṃ sa bon lnga/ yang dag btab | | 1mgrin pa drod kyi rang bzhin yin pas ra kha zas la reg pas ha/ der bad kan gsog pas sa| de thams cad la as khyab pas i 2gnas pa ste zer 3kha zas 4bcu bzhi pa ste paṃ lte bar a 'dab bzhir ra ha sa ya bsgom rkan du ra dang thams cad du/ / de la rlung 'byung ba na phyi'i yi ge bzhi las rlung dang*/

'jug tsam na de la bstim la mnan/ sa bon ra ha sa ya/ bzhi ni dam pa a nyid/ / tshigs chen bcu gnyis dang der ma zad de chos kyi 'khor lo yang gnas/ po'i re mig snying khar| gnas der bcu gsum pa'i lte bar hūm̐ bcus/ ni/ /sa bon lnga ra ha sa ya a/ ni mdzes pa nyid | | lnga'i nang nas ha ni dbyangs kyi drug pa u dang*/ ldan par/ / hūm̐/ thig les mnan pas mngon te yid rnam shes rnam par shes par hūm̐/ yongs su grags/ / hūm̐ gi nang gi rlung sems 'dres pa'i bin dhu ni ha bde sdug thams cad la khyab/ yi rnam pas thams cad du/ / bde ba la ji ltar khyab ce na/ sangs rgyas bdud rtsi lnga/ thams cad 'dus pa'o zer kun dang spyan la sogs pa dang*| mnyam par lte ba phab tsam na ha 'byung*/ sbyor/ / ba las lhan skyes 'byung tsa na yang ha 'byung*/ rtsa las aṃ sgra yi tshul de/ las lte bar/ byung ston zhing*/ / bsgom pa'i dus su yin la tha mal pa tsam na'ang*| 1de bza' ba'i 2sgrub pa po 3bza' bsrung gi dam tshig bsten/ de gang gi spyod yul na dam tshig spyod pa ste dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dbyer med du bsten pas byang sems rgyas la des rgyu bde bas 'bras bu bde ba'o/ / spyod pa'i bde ba la longs spyod pas bsrung*/ spyod yul nyid/ / saṃ bha ra'i rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po'i don/ gdams ngag dang ma phrad na 'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba/ / rang gi ngo bo dus thams cad pa rnams thog ma dbus mthar yang dag gnas/ / 1de nyid ji lta bu zhe na 2dpe bsrub bya/ dang srub byed sbyor ba de lta bu rtogs pa de snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba dang 'dra/ las/ / de bzhin du rang byin rlabs las kyang rtogs par nus so ji lta ba ni de bzhin no | | 1da ni rlung gi 'gros kyi dbang gis mngon du byed pa ston te/ 2 sems kyi rtag 'gro ba'i rgyas bshad 3thugs kyi sgo nas 'bar 'dzag gi dbang gis rang byung gi ye shes mngon du byas pa na 2 lte ba'i aṃ 3skyobs

sngags ba zlas 'khor bas/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i/ bsam gtan rnam rtog sreg pas sbyin sreg rtog pa sdom pas gṛh+na/ la sogs ldan/ /rgyud bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po/ 2he badz+ra rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bcu pa las las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa las/ yas sna na rkyang ma dang kun 'dar gyi nus pa pha thob kyi byang sems bzung*/ mas sna ro ma dang ma thob kyi rak+ta bzung*/ rtsa rgyud du/ rkyang ma mi bskyod 'bab ma ste/ /ro ma de bzhin khrag 'bab cing*/ /shes rab zla ba 'bab bshad pa/ /de ni kun 'dar mar rab grags/ / gang gsungs mnyan par gyis/ / 'di nyid kyi 'od nas bzlas pa 'khor zhes so| |g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa ro rkyang*/ gnyis ka ko la'i lte ba/ skye gnas dbus su dhū tī/ ni/ / dhū tī g.yon rkyang ma/ dang g.yas ro mar/ su de bzhin du/ / tha mal tsa na byang sems bzung ba de dbu ma'i ya rtse smin mtshams na rkyang ma'i nus mthu bzung nas gnas pa g.yon rkyang ma/ du tha mal tsa na/ khu ba rnam shes bya/ / yang dbu ma'i ma rtse na rak+ta ro ma'i nus pa bzung nas gnas g.yas pa la yang khrag nyid de/ / dhū tī yas snas khu/ mas snas khrag bzung ste de'ang ro rkyang gi nus pa'o/ / de de nyid phrad na gcig gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings nyid 'dus pa yin/ /smṛ tis yi phan tshun bsdu ba yang*/ / 'bar 'dzag gnyis ka la chos kyi dbyings ni sdud pa yin/ / g.yon nas shu kra bab pa de nyid las tīr tī ka snying 'di byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor la dgongs pa yin/ de'ang rkyang ma gsung*/ ro ma skur bshad pa rlung la dgongs/ stobs sku dang rdul snang ba/ lus/ stong pa/ shes rab/ sems/ mtshan mo/ gzhan dbang*/ aṃ/ mched pa/ ngag sems byung*/ shin stong*/ nyi ma/ thabs/ nyin mo/ kun btags| a/ dag bcas/ / g.yas nas rak+ta phab pa la ro ma/ mun dhū tīr mi rtog pa/ pa sems snang thob/ yid/ ma rig pa/ stong pa chen po/ sgra gcan/ zung 'jug mtshan mo/ yongs grub/

hūm̐/ kyi rang bzhin las/ / phyi rol gyi ltar snang snying stobs khu ba rak+ta khrag ni ngag rin chen rdul/ / rin 'byung khu ba zhes sbyar/ khu khrag gnyis ka mun pa mi rtog pa/ bskyed par byed pa nyid/ / de'i nyams myong dpe ji lta bu zhe na/ rdo rje pad yin bskyed byed gang yin na/ mo dang po dbang dus dang*| mnyam sbyor bas/ / skyes pa lta bu'o/ /shu kra dngos de las ci skye na/ dang dngos med bde ba|mi rtog par ro gcig gyur/ / byang sems de yang bshang dri chen dri chu shel me tog /lnga pa de bzhin byang chub sems/ /zer/ dang gci ba bad sha snabs la smṛ tis bshad/ kan dang*/ khrag dang de rnams kyi dwangs ma/ lnga pa khu ba nyid/ / ting nge 'dzin dang lus bskyed cing gsal bdud gong bu'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi lnga/ zer/ rtsi lnga yi gong bu'i dngos/ / yin pa mngon du byed pa de phyir bdud rtsi lnga po rgyal ba lnga'i ngo bo yin pas/ rdo rje can 'dir brjod/ / rtsa gnyis po de'i kun rdzob kyi las bstan te pha'i g.yon nas byang sems/ ma'i g.yas nas khrag rus pu tra'i/ pa rkang dang khu ba ni | g.yon/ / pha 'i shu kra las skyes par de bzhin gsungs/ gnyis ka /tha mal tsam na ma'i gsum pags pa dang ni sha dang pu g.yas ma'i gcig tra'i khrag / gnyis ka ma 'i rak+ta/ las skyes pa zhes byar grags/ / bu tsha'i khams drug lus kyi gong bu mdor bsdu na/ /de tsam zhig ni bstan pa yin/ /zer gong bu'i bsdu ba rnams kyi yang*/ /tshad dam nus pa/ ni pha ma'i khu khrag las byung ba/ 'di dag gsungs pa ste/ / bu tsha'i gong yang nang tshan gyi pha las skyes pa dang ma las skyes pa/ bu gcig pu pha ma'i/ gnyis su 'gyur/ /gnyis su gyur pas drug du ma rnams | | gong bu gcig pu du ma'i rang bzhin gyis/ / bu tsha'i rang bzhin gyi rdor sems de phyir rdo rje can 'dir gsungs// de ltar bskyed pa de yang rtsa yi kun spyod nyid tsaṇ+ḍā lī bsgom pa dang las su/

gsungs pa/ / rtsa'i de yi sgo yang rnam pa gnyis/ de gnyis la/ de gnyis kyi sgo las ni zhes snang*/ /de rnams skye gnas su/ 'du ba'i dus su ni/ / bu tsha'i lus rang bzhin gyi lha lha yi dmigs par 'gyur ba yin/ / 1tsaṇ+ḍā lī bco lnga pa chos 'khor gyi lte bar thig le la sde pa brgyad kyis bskor ba ste/srog gis lte bar sdud/rtsol bas mar 'phul bas chos kyi 'khor lo chags pa'o/ / 2'dir rlung gi stong thun sbyar 3chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar sde brgyad kyis bskor ba sprul 'khor du sdud cing*| rtsol ba'i rlung gis yar 'phul bas chos kyi 'khor lo tsha 'ubs pa 4ro ma kha gyen 5sgo de gnyis nas sgo gang nas/ rlung gi 'gro 'ong steng gi sgo min la/ dang 'og rkyang ma kha 'og spyi nyid de/ / sgo gnyis kyi byed las ston 'og gi sgos ni rnam par nang du 'jug bab pas 'tsho/ pas 'tsho bar byed pa/ shes// phyir steng gi sgos ni phyir byung bas 'chi bar byed pas/ dbyings bsreg pas/ steng gi sgo ru khams rnams dang*/ /zer/ nang du 'jug pas nyid do/ / sgo dgu'i rtsa bcu las byung ba'i byang sems 'dus pas rtsa ni ldang rngub kyi tshul/ thams cad lte bar dbu mar/ mnyam sbyor ba/ / tsam na/ byang sems thams cad dbu mar rnal rnal 'byor pas ni rtsa rnams kun/ /bsdus nas 'jug par bsam par bya// 'di la lam gsum pa 'phros 'byor pas ni rkyang ma nas/ 'jug par bya/ /de yi lus kyi 1rtsa ro ma 2spyi gtsug 3steng 4sna gnyis la bya sgo la yang*/ / 1srog rlung bzhugs pa de las gzhan yang shugs kyis shes rdo rlung bzhi mgon po bzhi/ rje can ni rtag rgyun thugs kyi sgo gnyis po dang*/ bzhugs | | sna bug gnyis steng steng sgo nas ldang ba'i rlung*/ 'og sgo nas 'jug pa'i rlung*/ dhū tī gnas pa'i rlung*/ gi sgor ni sbyor ba 'jug gnas ldang ba/ 'phrul 'khor gsum zer gsum/ / de la gnas pa'i rlung gi ngo bo dang dbye ba ste rgyu/

sgo gang nas sgo dgu nas 'khor gyi tshul gyis rgyu/ rnams kyi rlung dgu gsum po la/ yongs su u pa de sha bskor/ / rgyas par bshad kye bcom ldan 'das | sbyor ba gsum ni ci zhes bshad/ /ji ltar gang gi rnam pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhi yi/ / sgo gnyis sems kyi rtag tu 'gro 'ong byed/ ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / gsum pa nyid du sbyor bas na sbyor ba gsum ste rnam pa gsum du dbye bas sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyi mchog dang 'bring dang tha mar gnas pa'o/ / gsum nyid sbyor ba sbyor ba ldang 'jug gnas pa/ gsum/ / 'dir bla ma rlung gi ngo bo la sbyar te gsung*/ kha cig sgo de nyid la sbyar te 'chad

rnam gsum dbye bas rnam par gnas//sku 'i sgo gsung gi sgo/ thugs kyi sgo/ rang bzhin gyis/ / mdor bstan/kā tha ma/ ya tha ma 'bring po waka 'bring*/ dam pa tsit+ta/ dam pa/ nyid/ / nir/ 1lus grub pa la sbyar ba dang rlung la sbyar ba gnyis gsung 2dhū tī 3rab tu rgyas par bshad 4nor las rgyal gyi rlung lus thams cad kyi rten ka ba gcig le'u dgu par bstan/ dang sgo de la snal ma dgu sgril ltar srog la sogs pa dgu rgyu ba/ dgu sgo gsum gyi dbye ba'i sgo nas bstan/ pa// brten pa phra ba phung po lnga rags pas sbom po lnga ni lhag rlung lnga po phung po lngas 'byung ba lnga/ pa'i lha/ rgyal ba lnga po rigs lnga/ snang ma dgu po mig la sogs pa dgur son bug pa dgur ni son pa'i sgo | | dgu yi rnam par yongs su grags/ / 1sku yi sgo ni tha ma ste/ /zer 2 sku gcig pu yin pas 3de nas 'khor ba'i rgyu 'ba' zhig /nā ro/gsung tha ma'i sgo ni oṃ zhes pa lus kyi sgo nas lus khyab| skur ldan pa/ / la sogs pa'i dal rgyu bas/ sbom po lha ni ka tri las/ spyan sogs sprul pa'o | | 1gang gi 'di zhes sems ldan de/ /skyes bu rnal 'byor pa zhes bya/ /zer 2rnal 'byor pa'i ming gi rnam grangs kyi rlung lnga bstan 3ye shes rdo rje kun las btus cha mthun 4gnyis ka nas rgyu ba'i rlung ser po sems dang skyes bu bcings pa ste sa'i/ skyes dal ba chu dkar po/ bu g.yas nas/ can/ blangs pa ste me'i ser po/ g.yon nas rgyu ba khyad myur ba ste rlung gi ljang ser/ par rnal 'byor pa yi don// ngag gi sgo nas ldang 'jug rtag dus/ par kun tu dus su ni/ / 1dang po lte ba sogs rang rang gi gnas nas/de nas dhar tsaka gi 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi nas rgyus nas mthar kun tu khyab pa'o// 2gsung gi sgo nas rim pas nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga gsung 3ro ma nas 'gro dang rkyang ma nas/ 'ong ba'i khyad par las/

/ 1ye shes rdo rje kun las btus par mi gsal ba gsal 2rten sems can ston 3gzugs la sogs pa rags pa 'dzin pas sa sogs gsungs 4sa rlung du sbyar 5nā ro pa'i dpyid thig gi bshad pa gcig rkang medazer/ dang rkang chu rlung/ gcig rkang me rlung*/ gnyis dang*/ / rlung gi rlung rkang bzhi las ni 'dis bstan/ sogs pa yi/ / gyen rlung rlung la sogs pa'i rab dbye bas// ldang 'jug rtag tu 'gro ba rlung rnam bzhi/ / 'dis nam mkha'i rlung mi rgyu bar mngon sems/ zhus pa ji ltar zhes pa'i don sems bzhi ka'i rlung thugs kyi sgo gnyis nas/ kyi gnas pa rnam pa gnyis | | rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis nas nub nang*/ dang rab rgyu'i cho ga yi/ / nus pa rtag tu gnas pa ste/ /rgyu ba 'gro dang 'ong ba yin/ / yin rtag tu nub dang rab rgyu ba/ / 'dod khams pa'i sems sngar gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi ka la/ can kun la dam pa rnams gyen du 'gro ngan pa rnams thur du/ 'gro 'ong byed/ ba'o/ / 'gro 'ong gi dbang gis ji ltar mngon du 'gyur zhe na de ltar rlung bzhi po rlung sbyangs pas phyi rol gyi rtog pa srog rtsol gyi phyi rgyu nang rgyu la shes pa gtad pas yid zin te sum mdo'i me sbar/ dang rlung 'gags te nang du me'i nus pa drod skyes pas haṃ las byang sems phab pas lte bar mngon du byas pas lte bar bde ba chen po mngon du byas pa'o/ / gang zhig 'gro 'ong byed pa/ mi rig pa/ / 'gags pa'o/ de nyid bshad pa sems sa'i rlung 'gags/ med chu'i rlung*/ skyes bu med pa dang*/ / me rlung yid dang ldan pa med pa dang*/ / 1rlung gi rlung 2bcu drug pa sprul 'khor gyi lte bar nyi zla'i bar du thig le las 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung 'byung ba dang 'jug pa bgrang ba'o/ /3de bzhi 'gags pas gnyis med ye shes mngon du 'gyur rnal 'byor pa yi don med pa/ / 1g.yas g.yon du sa rlung sogs bzhi dang*/ spyi bor nam mkha'i

'di 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe rgyu ba yin gyi da lta rgyu shugs chung ba yin/ rlung zin pas bde ba skye/ des mi rtog pa shugs kyis bskyed/ des lte sogs su go rim bzhin du du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rim gyis mthong ngo 2pad+ma mgon po 3g.yas nas 4'di rnams kyis mgo drangs nas nyis brgya nyer lnga/ rgyu bas rlung gi mtshan nyid bstan me nyid dang ni gsum yin/ rlung las kyi mgon po/ dang ni/ / rin chen mgon po dbang chen dang ni de bzhin rdo rje mgon po/ chu/ / rlung bzhi 'khor chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma bzhi la brten nas/ lor thugs zer/ sems kyi kun thugs kyi 'khor lo rgyu ba las/ zer spyod pa/ / sgo gnyis nas 'gro 'ong byed/ me rlung steng du sor bzhi 'gro steng dang rlung gi rlung ngos nas sor drug ngos nam mkha' yi ni mnyam par zer/ dang sa rlung thad sor bcu drug brang chu'i rlung 'og tu sor bcu gnyis 'og tu/ 'gro/ / rkyang ma zla ba ro ma nyi ma'i spyi gtsug thugs kyi sgo rab dbye bas/ / thugs kyi gsum pa'i sgo ni yid dang bcas/ / rkyang ma nas 'jug rngub dang ro ma nas ldang/ dbyung ba byed pa/sgo gnyis ka yang*/ / sgo gsum las sgo sa/chu/me/ rlung*/ nam mkha'/ yi dam pa nyid yin te/ / sems gtso bo dam pa yi ni sgo/ / spyi gtsug steng ro/ gsum dang rkyang 'og smin mtshams| tu rab tu grags/ / yang na rkyang ma nas byang sems 'bab pas 'tsho bar byed/ 'og ming gi rnam grangs/ gi sgo nas 'jug pa/ kha 'og tu bltas pas ra sa na/ yas sna smin rkang la thug sa ni rnam par shes/ / ra sa steng du kha bltas steng nas phyir 'byung bas 'chi bar byed/ ro ma'i mes bsreg par byed/ gi sgos la la na spyi gtsug tu/ ni dbyings nyid de/ / rlung lnga'am rnam snang lnga'i rlung*| la chos kyi 'khor lo'i bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ sogs sangs rgyas rlung lnga rnams/ / gser gyi sgo nas brgyud nas

steng nas phyir 'byung ba dang 'jug pa dang 'ong bar/ gi yang na sna bug gnyis/ sgor yang na yig 'bru lnga bsreg ni g.yo zhing gnas/ / par byed/bdud rtsi de rlung lnga po/ rnams 'og sgo ste smin mtshams brgyud de phyir 'byung ba'i tshul gyis gsung*/ tu rkyang ma nas/ rnam par gnas/ / 'dzag steng sgo nas gsung*/ spyi bo nas man ngag gis gtong*/ gi phyir/ gshegs sbor/ su bsreg gsol ba nyid | | 1spyan drangs zer 2rkyang ma nas nang du 3sangs rgyas rnams nang du dgug dang man ngag gi gshegs su ro ma nas phyir/ gsol ba yi/ /tshul gyi sgo gnyis nas/ sems ni rtag tu 'gro | | 'jug gnas ldang gsum gyi bdag nyid can dus 'khor lo gong ma gsum/ gsum bdud rtsi lnga| sangs rgyas rlung bzhi rigs bzhi/ thams cad dang*/ / 1'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs ma dang dbang po drug dang yul drug gi dwangs ma 2rlung lnga sangs rgyas lnga 3rlung mgon po bzhi'i/ dgu brgya pa phrag re re la ldang 'jug byed tsa na bdud rtsi'i rgyu 'gag nyis brgya nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga re la bya mkha' 'gro nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa re/ rnal 'byor ma mo 'byung ba bzhi/ de wi bzhi rnams/ / nang du 'jug cha 5 ཾ pa dang ni phyir/ ldog cha 6 ཾ pa la/ / rim pa bzhin yon cha 7 ཾ tan bdun/ skyon ni rab brjod pas | | 'bab rkyang*/ bde nang*/ dang bsreg ro sdug phyi/ bsngal rang bzhin gyis/ / de lta bu ngo bo nyid kyi lhan cig skyes pa grub pa'i gnas/ / pa de lam du byas pa'i tshe ye shes kyi rgyud rang bzhin gyi sprul pa yin pas gsung*/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ / de rnams la rang bzo spang pa bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ lha bdag med ma'am rdo rje phag mo/ mos ni/ / nang gi bde ba bo la kak+ko lar bcug nas/ /sems dpa' chen po mnyes byas te/ / gong du rang byin rlabs zhus par ma zad tshig ni 'di dag yang gsol pa/

/ chos 'khor du hūm̐ bde ba kha 'bu bas dpyid ces bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ / aṃ thig me/ le lte/ bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ / rtsa mi phyed ma las/ sogs pa lus la/ ji ltar rtsa lha'i ngo bor/ gnas/ /de yi gnas mi phyed ma la sogs pa/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nang du ni ji ltar lags/ / phyir 'dzam bu gling pū yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ li ra sogs ci gsungs dang*/ / bskyed pa la tsakra gsum las 'khor lo lha/ dgod pa de bzhin las/ gzhan/ / nang du/ ji ltar rgyu bas/ rtsa yi lha rnams lus la/ rdzogs pa yi/ /de dri ba bzhi/ yi dbye ba bdag la ḍā kī ni khams kyi dwangs ma gsungs/ / gnas ming*/ dri ba gsum pa'i lan dang por bstan gsung bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /lha mo gnas/ rab bshad bya yis nyon/ / gsang ba las ni ches/ gsang ba/ chen mchog / le'u lnga pa 'di las 'phros rtsa nang du/ yi phyi mkha' 'gro ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhugs pa rnams/ rang bzhin gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ la sogs pa sa bcu po nyid/ dang*/ / pha rol tu phyin pa'i byang sems sa bcu la longs spyod pa bzhin gsang sngags pa yang lus kyi gnas la sogs pa rnams mgo zug pa dang*/ longs spyod pa dang thim pas spyad pha rol tu phyin pa'i sa bcu la spyod pa bzhin gsang sngags kyi theg par lus kyi sa bcu la mgo zug sogs/ sku dang rang bzhin/ gsung dang thugs kyi 'khor lor son pa mtshan/ gnas kyi nang gi rab tu rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bcu bzhi pa dang cha mthun/ dbye bas nyi shu rtsa bzhi gsungs/ 'di la phyi bskyed pa lus mthar thug go / spyi bo mā la yā yi yul/ /de bzhin spyi gtsug 'bar ba nyid | de bzhin du ni oṃ ḍi nyid/ /rna ba g.yas pa nyid du brjod/ / gzhung pa na gsung rtsibs ma'i rgyab ni arbu da/ /bzhi ni gnas zhes bya ba'o/ /rna ba g.yon pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /de bzhin go dā wa rīr shes/ /dga' ba'i dbang phyug bshad pa ni/ / smin ma'i dbus gnas rab tu bskul/

/de bzhin mig dag lha mo'i mkhar/ / lag pa'i rtsa bar mā la wa/ /bzhi ni nye ba'i gnas nyid de/ / chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa thugs 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha dang sbyar na gzhal yas khang 'phar ma bzhi pa'i lte bar rat+na'i rigs/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ de'i phyi rol tu thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sngon po rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba/ de la lha mo brgyad| kyi 'khor lor rnam par gnas/ / lus kyi cha shas brgyad po nyid/ der gnas pa'i rtsa la gnas kyi khyad par rang bzhin gyi/ / lus kyi cha shas brgyad/ mkha' spyod rnams thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha mo brgyad/ kyi gnas su/ yang dag bshad/ /mchan khung kā ma rū pa nyid/ / nu ma o trer rab tu grags/ /'di dag zhing du yang dag brjod/ /lte ba tri sha ku ner brjod/ /sna yi rtse mo ko sa la/ /nye ba'i zhing du brjod pa'o/ kha ni ka liṅka ru brjod | | mgrin pa lam+pā ka ru gsungs/ /ts+tshan+dho ha zhes rnam par bshad/ /snying ni kāñtsir brjod pa ste/ /dbang po pho mtshan/ hi mā la ya nyid/ / kha ba'i gnas/ nye ba yi ni ts+tshan+dhor brjod/ / brgyad po dang de ltar yul rnams thams cad du/ /gsung gi 'khor lo rnam par gnas/ / rtsibs brgyad dmar po pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba'o/ de yul gyi cha shas rnams la gnas kyi khyad par gyi tshul gyi ni/ / der rtsa sa spyod rnams kyi gnas su/ yang dag bshad | | bo la'i rtse rtags la yi dwags lhag par gnas/ / bshang ba'i laṃ gsang ba la ni khyim gyi lha/ /yi dwags 'du bar brjod pa'o/ /brla ni saurāṣ+ta ru brjod | | rje ngar gnyis ni gser gl̥ng gi /rang gi ngo bor rnam par shar/ /nye ba yi ni 'du ba nyid/ /sor mo nā ga ra ru brjod/ /rkang pa'i rgyab ni sin+dhur nges// dur khrod du ni yang dag brjod/ /mthe bong la ni ma ru zer/ /pus mo ku lu tā ru brjod | | de na gnas pa'i rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di dag nye ba'i dur khrod nyid/ de/ /mkha' 'gro mar

'i gnas su/ ni gsungs pa'o/ / sku 'khor rtsibs brgyad dkar po 'khor lo'i phreng bas bsngor ba'o/ / 'di dag yul kha/ dang rang lus skyes/ /rang gi nang dang phyi rol phyi rol du yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ nang du rang gi lus kyi cha shas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas/ / la gsum ste kā ya wa ka tsit+ta/ bsdu na sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ / phyi rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi nang du rtsa nyi phyi nang du/ shu rtsa bzhir dbye ba yi/ / dbye na/ phyi mkha' 'gro ma nang du/ ni kun gyi gnas | | thams cad du ni yang dag bshad/ / rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'di rnams gnas su mkha' 'gro ma/ / nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo/ /nang du rtsa yi gzugs kyi rnam pa yang dag gnas/ dri ba gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i lan bstan gsung*/ /drug pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// // le'u drug pa de nyid rtsa'i 'khor lo dang dbye ba'i sgo nas bstan de drug 'phros/ nas gzhan yang rtsol bas bsgrub pa las ma byung bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i ji ltar gnas su nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ son pa'i phra ba/ rtsa'i 'khor lo bshad par bya'o/ / 1thog mar dpyid bstan pa sho lo ka gsum| tsaṇ+ḍā lī bcu bdun pa chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar thig le bsgom pa'o/ /de las thig le mu tig lta bu lte bar babs par bsam 2rtsa'i 'khor lo dpyi thig cha/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga der kha bskang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba sogs bco lnga pa dang cha mthun/ de gnyis phyogs gcig tu byas pas gsal bar byed pū li ra sogs cha/ de ltar gsum phyogs gciga'adi dang bzhis le'u dang po/ 3ḍā kī bcu gcig pa na snying gi nang son pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa snying por bcas/ /de yi nang du son pa'i rtsa/ / brten pa rtsa'i ngo bo mar me'i ltar gsal ba/ rang gi ngo bo can/ / rtsa de la brten pa'i bde ba mar me lta bu yin pas rtsa de la yang de skad ces bya'o/ /rten gyi dbyibs chu shing gi ni me tog ltar/

/ brkyang zhing kha ni 'og tu'o/ / rten de la brten pa de yi nang gnas dpa' bo thig le/ ni/ / tshad yungs dkar gyi ni sbom phra tsam/ / aṃ gi me dang thag ring bas mi bde ba chen po'i haṃ nas thabs kyis lam du byas tsa na shigs rten rtsa la gnas pa'i byang sems/ hūm̐ gi rnam pas gnas/ sa bon ni/ / byang sems kha ba lta bu 'dzag pa nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi snying khar babs tsa na| dga' ba/ / chos kyi 'khor lo'i hūm̐ las byang sems 'dzag pas yid dga' ba bskyed pas dpyid bde ba kha 'bu bas/ ces bya bar rnam par bshad/ / phyi'i rgya mtsho la rgod ma kha'i me zhes bya ba yod pa des chu bo bzhi po thams cad kyang mi 'phel/ de bzhin lte bar yang tshangs pa'i me yod pas ci phab kyang mi 'phel rgod ma'i me yi gzugs kyis ni/ / nang ltar bshad pa'i bdag med ma ni lte ba'i aṃ/ thig rtog pa'i zur med pas/

ler brjod/ / bshang sgo'i las byed pa'i las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis/ / sum mdo'i me lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar/ / chos kyi 'khor lo dpyid thob pa yi byang sems aṃ gi gnas su/ chog shes pas/ / tshim par byed pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang lte ba gnyis snyoms nang gi par 'jug pas rnam par gnas/ / chos kyi 'khor lo'i thig le dpa' bo shrī ni he ru ka /'di ni dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba/ ra brjod | | rnal 'byor ma yi aṃ/ gzugs 'dzin ma/ / de thig le'o/ rten g.yo ba la gnas pa rgyu dang rten mi g.yo ba la gnas pa/ mi rgyu bcas par la rang bzhin gyis/ gnas/ / lus thams cad kyi dwangs ma 'bab/ 1nir 2ka sku sbor/ ro// 1rnam 2'bab rkyang*/ gsung gsung baṃ/ 1grangs 2dhar thugs 1gnas/2dhū tī/ kyi dbye ni/ ba rtsa gsum la yang gsung*/ yis/ / am̐ me ru/ sku'i sgo sogs sgo ni rnam pa rtsa/ gsum rlung*/ byung bas/ / rlung 'gro ro ma nas/ ba dang ni thun re la dgu brgya pa phrag re rkyang ma nas/ 'ong bar byed/ / 'dod khams pa 'di ni kun gyi lus la gnas// lte bar a de/ a yig gzugs kyis ni/ / a de thung bcod brgyad pa tsaṇ+ḍā lī 'khor lo bzhi'i lte bar so so'i yi ge bkod nas gtum mo spro zhing sdud pa'o/ / ngu ru ni brjod pa gcig pas/ rab tu grags | | thig le gcig las med pas/ snying la yang ni hūm̐ nyid de/ / ha ring zhabs kyu ring*/ po ma mo u aṃ/ gnyis dang gnas/ / yang na dhar tsaka na thig le gnyis/ mgrin par oṃ gyi gzugs kyis ni/ / a o a ཾ ma mo 'dren pa zhes bya ba gsum tshad/ thig le gsum/ gsum brjod pu lu ta mgor sring*/ / dpral bar haṃ gi rnam pa 'di/ / u'i dbyibs sgra kha'i cha ha'i ཾ khog pa'i a/ dang thig le klad kor/ gtum mo dang thag ring bas sam yang na rtog pas mi shigs pa | | 'khor lo bzhi yi rab dbye bas/ / 'khor lo bzhi po de nyid la mas rim pas sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*/

/ nang ltar gyi thun 'khor lo bzhi las rlung bzhir rgyu ba la bya ste nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa phrag bzhi la zer/ bzhir byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ / 'khor lo pad+ma yi ge bzhi las byung ba dang*/ / ji snyed yod pa'i chos ji lta ba bzhin gtan la dbab pa dga' ba bzhi yi ngo bo yis/ / shin tu rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po sogs rnal 'khor lo bzhi la sbyar| 'byor bzhi ni mngon du'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba 'am bde/ ba'i ngo bo yis/ / rtog pa mang bas bya dang byed pa'i dngos po la//rdo rje sems dpa'i bde ba chen po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /'dir ni tsakra bzhir/ ji ltar bde bar rol/ / chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams kyi bzhi la yang*/ / de nyid 'byung ba bzhi yi rlung rgyu ba'i/ rtsa rnams yin pas| ni/ / gsal ba mar me'i rang bzhin lta bu las/ /phyogs bzhi la ni rnam par gnas | | mtshams kyi rtsa rnams bzhi yang mtshams rnams su/ /rnam par gnas shing dbus/ der son hūm̐/ pa'ang*/ / re re nas kyang bdud rtsi lnga lnga 'bab bdud rtsi lnga ni 'bab pa ste/ / mtshams bzhi'i rtsa las bdud rtsi lnga 'dzag pa de logs kyi 'byung ba bzhi rgyas par shes pas gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ / de mchod mi rtog pa rgyas par byed pas/ rang gi gzugs gnas pas/ /de yi rtsa la bdud rtsi 'dzag pas/ dngos po'i ngo bo las/ / yang na mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi las bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma 'bab pa'o/ / mchod phyi'i mchod pa la sogs bzhi las bzhi pa ste de kho na'i mchod pa gsung pa rtsa/ bzhi pa/ ni rnam par bshad/ /lus can/ kyi snying kha'i nang du ni | | gtso bo gsum/ gtum mo bdud dral ma dang nā ro/ lnga rtsa rnams ro rkyang gnyis la gnyis su phye bas| lnga ni rnam par gnas/ / smad sku sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du 'dir lnga bsnan pas sum cu rtsa bdun no/ / gsung bar/ stod thugs 'khor lo gsum/ kyi dbye ba yis/ / rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhir nye bar brjod/

/gnas sogs lus kyi cha shas la/ dbye ba la gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ nas/ / gnas dang gnas la rnam par gnas/ / de'i steng du sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnam par dag pa'i rtsa brgyad bsnan pas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rtsa'i cha/ spyi bor yang dag gzhan yang 'gre/ byung ba yi/ / rtsa ni spyi bo skyes zhes brjod/ / zha lagaX zhus thams cad la khyab/nyi shu rtsa bzhi nang du rdul sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang nas/ 'dod rkyang*/ chags dang snying zhe ro/ sdang*/ stobs mun gti mug dbu ma/ pa'i tshul/ / 1gyi rtsa gsum/2lam dang 'bras bu gnyis ka'i dus su/ sum cu rtsa gnyis po de yi nang nas gtso mo gsum po gtso/ ni/ / yin zer/ gnas gang ḍā kī las so/ / pū spyi bo/ rab gtum ma li rar ni bdag gi mi phyed ma'i byang sems las bdag nyid kyi so dang sen mo 'bab/ yang na pha ma'i mi phyed ma'i byang sems kyis bu tsha'i so dang sen mo bskyed/ mi phyed ma/ /so dang sen mo 'bab par brjod/ / spyi gtsug 'bar ba 'dzin par phra gzugs gtum mig ma/ /de bzhin skra dang ba spu 'bab/ / rna ba g.yas/ u rgyan gnas ni chen po la/ /rtse ba ma ni rnam par 'od ldan ma/ gnas/ /rna ba g.yas par gnas nas ni/ /pags pa dri ma 'bab ma gnas | | rtsibs logs arbu dar ni g.yon pa sna chen/ ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sha 'bab ma/ /gang zhig chu rgyus gnas pa'i rtsa/ /ba rna ba g.yon/ yi mchog sbyin rnam par gnas/ /de chu rgyus de sra ba'i tshul du yod pas/ ni sra ba'i tshul gyis 'bab pa'i dwangs ma| gnas/ /thung ngu ma ni rnam dpa' bo'i blo ma/ par bshad/ / smin 'i dbus gang zhig dga' ba'i dbang phyug na/ gnas/ / pa'i/ de bzhin rus sbal skyes mar grags/ / ḍā kī ni mi thung ma sra ba'i dngos pos gnas pa'i phyir/ /rus pa'i phreng ba bskyed par byed pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma/ 'khrugs par gnas/ / mig lha mo'i mkhar du gang zhig rtsa// lus la laṅka'i dbang phyug brjod 'jam pa sgom pa ma ru brjod/

/de ni rtag tu mchin pa 'bab | | pa/ de lta bu'i mkha' 'gro ma thams cad lus la lhag par gnas/ / lag pa'i rtsa ba mā la war ni dbang ma ni/ /rgyal ba'i dbang phyug shing grib ma/ snying la bskyed pa'i dwangs ma 'bab/ gnas/ / de yan chad thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' spyod/ mchan khung na gnas pa'i rtsa ni gang zhig mig 'bab pa/ /'dod pa'i lus la/ gzugs su rnam par gnas/ / gzugs ni bskyed par byed pa'i/ mthong bar 'dod pa 'i khams kyi dwangs ma/ ste/ /skyon ruX pa gsum la 'dom gnyis 'byung*/ ldan ma zhes rnam par e ra wa ti/ bshad/ / nu ma o trer mkhris pa 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /gang zhig 'jug ma mtshan 'jigs byed ma/ mor brjod/ / lte ba tri sha ku ner byung ba 'i rtsa/ ni/ /ma mo nges par rlung gi shugs ma/ snga ོ ba bskyed pa'i dwangs ma| 'bab/ / sna'i rtse mo ko sa lar ni mtshan mo nyid/ / chang 'thung ma/ rgyu ma'i phreng bzang khyab cing bskyed pa'i dwangs ma/ 'bab/ / kha ka liṅkar ni bsil ljang lha mo zer/ sbyin ma/ / ngos kyi chu rgyus bskyed pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma/ yang dag bshad/ / mgrin par tsha ba ma ni shin tu bzang mo/ lto ba 'bab/ gnas ltor gnas shin tu bzang mor nges zer/ nges/ / de nyid lam+pa mgrin pa/ kar ni rab tu grags/ / gzhol ma tshad ma nyid rta rna ma/ ni kāñtsir snying*/ gnas | | thams cad du ni bshang ba bskyed pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma/ 'bab/ / mdoms ky-i mtshams kyi mtha' dbu skyega~X pa'i rgyus pa 'bab/ yi nang du yang*/ bshang lci gnyis kyi bar chu so'i rtsa| de nyid la kha ba'i hi mā la ru rangs ma'i gdong*/ gnas su byang sems 'bab/ rangs pa'i rtsa ḍā ki ni zhes bya gdong*/ gsung gi 'khor lo sa spyod/ 1sku'i 'khor lo bstan shin rtsa/ tu gzugs can bad kan ldan/ 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/rtags rtse yi dwags lhag gnas yang dag gnas | | gang zhig rtag tu rnag 'bab pa/ / bshang lam khyim gyi lhar ni yang dag gnas | | 'kha' 'gro dam pa'i dbang phyug

dum skyes/ ma/ /spyi ma nyid du rnam par bshad | | brla so'u rāṣ+tar ni gang zhig rtsa/ / chang tshong ma rgyu sbyin ma ste dmar po khrag 'bab | | tha mal pa/ rngul ni 'bab par gyur pa 'i rtsa de/ ni/ / rje ngar gser gling du ni yang dag bshad/ / gnas/ yan lag gzi brjid kun khyab pa/ / rtsa sbyor bral mar ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ rab tu grags/ / rkang pa'i sor mo nā ga rar ni sdug gu shin tu dpa' mo| ma/ /tshil can sbom zhing myos byed 'bab/ / rkang pa'i rgyab sin+dhur shin tu grub ma stobs chen ma/ nyid/ /mya ngan dang*/ mchi ma bskyed pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma/ 'bab par brjod// mthe bong ma rur gnas ma lud pa/ ska ma po/ 'bab/ /'tshed pa ma zhes rnam 'khor los sgyur ma/ par bstan/ / pus mo gnyis ku lu tār ni yid bzang brtson chen ma/ ma/ /byis pa'i sha zer/ snabs ni lhag ma rtsa brgyad dar gcig phyogs kyi bzhi rlung kho na gnas/ mtshams kyi bzhi bin du kho na gnas pas/ pos sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga/ rlung sems 'dres pa yod/ snying po'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ gtso bo yab yum dang lnga lte de ltar na rtsa de rnams lus kyi khams thams cad la khyab pa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis phan 'dogs pas logs su ma bgrang ngo gsung*/ 'bab ma'o/ /drug pa las yul yul gang na rtsa gang gnas pa/ gyi dgod pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// // 1gsum par kha bskang*/ lnga bcu par cha mthun/ mi gsal ba gsal bar byed/ gang tshe mgrin par sogs bcu gcig pa/ da du bdag sogs bco lnga pa cha mthun/ gsal bar byed 2phyi rol tu rnal 'byor ma dang 'dus nas dkyil 'khor dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ mchod pa byed pa bzhin du lha rgyud kyi rim pa de nyid dkyil 'khor dang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bstan/ lags nyan par 'tshal lags na/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'di las le'u brgyad par 'brel mchod pa las | | bzlas pa sogs pa'i las ni ji ltar lags/

/ nang gi sbyin sreg las ni mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / sum cu rtsa bdun nang du rtsa sum cu rtsa bdun du gnas he ru ka la sogs pa'i lha | | rtsa gzugs mdzes pa 'i ngo bo/ ra yang dag byung*/ / gzhal yas khang lus ni dkyil 'khor bde ba'i gnas yin pas/ nyams dga' ba/ /sgo yang na sku'i sgo sogs bha ga'i sgo ste/ rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi gcig du byas pa dang bzhi/ bzhi rlung bzhi/ ji skad gsungs pa'o/ /rang gi yan lag dpung pa dang lag ngar la sogs pa/ brgyad byung bas/ /ka ba de yis bskor nas gnas | | dngos po kun gyis chu zheng 'dom/ mnyam pa'i phyir/ /gru bzhi par ni rab tu grags/ /sku lte ba/ gsung mgrin pa/ thugs snying kha/ kyi ngo bos ni/ / lus nyid la 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid brjod/ ni gcig tu gsungs/ /ri 'i rgyal po ri rab/ ni mgo bo'i ze 'bru la/ / bde ba/ 'byung ba rim tseg gi dod ji ltar rtsom chen la sogs rim/ / bla ma'i dus kyi man ngag gi thabs rim nyid kyis/ /de ni lus rang la 'byung ba rim rtseg rdzogs par dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis te sngags kyis bskyed mi dgos/ gnas/ / mdo/ rgyas pa rkang lus la 'byung ba rim rtseg gi dkyil 'khor ji ltar gnas she na/ pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung | | gzhu yi dbyibs su rnam par gnas/ /sum mdo yi ni gnas su ni/ /de bzhin gru gsum 'bar ba nyid/ /zlum po'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /chu ni lto bar rnam par gnas//snying khar yang ni sa nyid de/ /kun nas gru bzhi pa nyid do// ri rab kyi steng gi dpag bsam gyi shing ni sgal tshigs so/ /yang na mgo bo ni ri rab kyi mgo bo lta bu yin la| ri rab byin po lta bu'i sgal tshigs so/ / sgal tshigs dbyug gu'i gzugs kyis ni/ /ri rab ri rgyal smad kyi cha/ de bzhin no/ / lha'i gdan der ni spyi bo'i char gnas pa/ / sna tshogs pad+ma'i dod

'dam skyes 'dab ma sum cu gnyis/ / 1yang na rtsa la ā li kā li dgod gsung na 2ha'i khog pa aṃ byang sems dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi rnam par gnas pa 3lha'i sa bon gyi dod dbyangs dang gsal byed mdzes par gnas/ / rten yin pas sum cu rtsa gnyis byang chub 'dod/ / phyir pad+ma'i nang du klad dar son pa gang*/ /de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor brjod/ / pa ni nang ltar/ spyi bo'i nang du klad pa ni/ /gang zhig gnas pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de ru gsungs/ / sa bon gyi dod de nang haṃ gi rnam pa ni/ /thig le'i gzugs can tsaṇ+ḍā lī dang thag ring bas/ mi shigs pa/ / haṃ las bdud rtsi babs pa de 'jig rten kun gyi lus gnas pa'i/ rtsa ba de/ / bskyed pa'i rgyu'am/ rten mi g.yo brtan pa'i bdag nyid brten pa/ g.yo ba'i bdag / rlung byang sems/ haṃ gi rnam pa gsal dang de'i bde ba/ mi gsal de'i byang sems/ gzugs las ni/ /sa bon gzugs kyis yang dag gnas/ / rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pas lus can rnams ni kun gyi gzugs/ /de phyir gdod nas rdzogs pa nyid/ / de yan chad rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ 'di man chad lam gyi dbang du byas pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan bdud haṃ las/ rtsi'i gzugs kyis 'dzag par ni | | nyin dang mtshan du rnam par gnas/ / byang sems de nyid kyi ni sgra 'byed cing*// lte ba'i aṃ kha 'byed de dbu ma'o/ /am̐ drag du 'bar bar byed pas me ni dga' bar byed pa ste/ / byang sems des ni lte bar/ gang la dkyil 'khor byang sems/ ni/ /yin pa nyid du the tshom med/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor zhes byar gsungs/ / ci ste zhe na dngos po rnams kyi snying po bde ba chen po/ mchog / maṇ+ḍal la ste ma ma nu pa ra ste byang sems/ la la tu grih+na ste len pa 'am| la lum ts+tshe da ste rtog pa gcod/ de ni bdud rtsi lnga/ len cing rtog pa/ gcod pa'i phyir/ / lus la gnas pa'i byang sems/ ni dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/

/ rtsa'i dkyil 'khor bstan rtsa chen sum cu rtsa gnyis 'di mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis yin pas de la dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes bya gsung*/ kyi/ / dhū tī'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo byin po 'khor/ yang ni dkyil 'khor brjod// don dam gyi dkyil 'khor byang chub sems stong nyid snying rje gnyis med/ ni rin po che'i/ / dkyil 'khor dngos po thams cad/ la des khyab pas na/ de'i ngo bor len/ yang na/ de nyams su blangs pas/ de'i 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa len/ de nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ / lus phyi rol byang sems/ gyi dkyil 'khor kyang rdul tshon gsum du/

de nyid snang bcas pa'i gzugs nang nyid kyis/ /phyi na sna tshogs la/ khyab cing rnam par gnas/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor/ gzugs dang sgra la sogs | 1pa la 2 par yang snang*/ / dbang po thams cad 'jug pa'o/ / ste lus kyi dkyil 'khor| nang gi khu ba la sogs pa/ / dkyil 'khor gdod nas grub pa'i rdzas ni rnam par gnas/ /phyi rol lus/ bcas pa'i rtsa dang byang sems bde ba/ nang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje can gyi don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi la stong nyid snying rje gnyis med/ byang chub sems/ / nyid de thams cad du snang*/ khu ba sbom phyi'i/ dang nang gi /bde ba phra ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba'i phyi'i dkyil 'khor zhi ba la sogs pa'i las byed pas gnyen/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyis rtog pa spong bas gnyen/ gnyen zhi bde 'gro ba la phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pas dngos grub bskyed cing phan 'dogs pas gnyen/ gyi rang bzhin can/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ / dkyil 'khor gnyis po goms par bya ba las mi 'da' bas dam tshig don du gsungs pa ni/ / phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor goms pas skye ba 'dir/ / aṃ las sbar te yas phab pas bde ba mngon du byas te de'i dmigs pa dang ma bral bar bsgrub na/ sangs rgyas nyid ni thob par 'gyur | | der ma zad/ nyan nyan thos bden pa bzhi la dmigs nas bsgoms pas rtsa kha bye nas bde ba 'byung bar ma shes nas shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba 'dod/ thos rnams kyi sangs rgyas dang*/ / de bzhin rang rgyal rnams kyi dang*/ / rten 'brel bsgom mi dgos/tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams 'jig rten pa zhi sogs rags sogs bsgoms pas rtsa kha bye nas bde ba 'byung*| kyi/ / dngos grub/ dkyil 'khor gnyis/ goms pas rdzogs pa nyid/ / thob rang bzhin gyi sbyin sreg bstan/ shes rab me ni aṃ 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg gi me/ cher 'bar bar/ / nang gi bsreg rdzas nang gi khu ba la sogs

pa bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma/ dang*/ /de bzhin bla na med pa'i sbyin sreg gi bsreg rdzas/ phyi rol gzugs sogs par snang ba'i rtog pa/ kyi/ /bsreg rdzas kyis ni sbyin sreg bya/ / sbyin sreg gi lha skye mched sems dpa'/ drug dang gti mug rdo rje sogs| khams rnams lha mo bzhi/ dang*/ / rigs lnga phung sogs rnams kyi khyad par las// de rnams kyi ni gzugs can lha/ / sbyin sreg gi mchod pa'i rdzas de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma yul drug gi lha mo/ yul drug gi dwangs ma/ nyid ni/ / dbang po drug des ni sbyin sreg gi lha de mchod nang ltar 'di rnams yul drug gi dwangs mas mchod/ bla med ltar na gnyis med ye shes nyams su myong ba dang*| ro gcig pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa'i yul rnams bstan gsung*/ gang gi phyir/ /rnal 'byor yang na dbang po dang yul tha mi dad pa 'am/ dbyer med pa'i tshul gyis/ mchod par yang dag bshad | | bsreg rdzas kyi snod thod pa 'di ni gtso bo nyid/ /bsreg rdzas kyi ni mchog tu gsungs/ /blugs gzar ro mar bshad par ste/ /snying gi 'khor lor rkyang ma dag | dgang gzar zhes byar yang dag brjod/ / lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum mngon spyod kyi thab khung thab khung ltai ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ / rlung g.yab las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa yi | | tshangs pa'i me ni lte ba/ sum mdor gnas/ / phyi'i shin+taṃ la sogs pa'i dod sgra ni sngags am̐/ zhes a haṃ/ brjod pa ste/ / rang bzhin gyi bzlas pa ro ma nas sbor/ rkyang ma nas 'bab pa'i tshul gyis/ 'khor bar byed pa yin/ / rang bzhin gyi bsgom pa rang byung gi rnam par rtog pa/ mtshungs par snang ba nyid/ / don dam pa'i dkyil sbyin sreg gi 'khor ni yas phab pa dang bzhi gnas 'dres pas/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med gnyis med rnal 'byor phyir/ / de rdzogs pa 'am mngon du byas pa lhan rang bzhin gyis gnas pa/ cig skyes pa gzhon pa 'di/

/de ni nang du sgro 'dogs chod pas/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor rang bzhin| bdag po'i gzugs kyi phyir/ / sbyin sreg gi slob dpon la sogs pa thams cad kyi slob dpon sems kyi rgyal po gnyis med ye shes/ ste/ / zhes/e waṃ zer de skad phyi thams cad nang du tshang bar/ la sogs ci gsungs pa/ /rgyud ni zhes rgyud kyi rim pa la/ thams cad thabs shes rab kyi rgyud kyi don de ltar/ rtogs par bya/ /da dung bdag la nang gi sku gsum la zhus/ the tshom dmigs yul rgyud kyi rim pa de nyid ma tshang ba kha skong gi tshul du bstan de 'khor lo bzhi'i dbyibs dang yig 'bru dgod pa la sogs pa sngar ma bstan pa de ston/ zhar la dkyil 'khor gyi sku gsum yang dris/ mchis | | nang gi chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang*/ /bde ba chen po'i gzugs kyi ni/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa/ yang na rang byung gi ye shes/ mgon po gnas gang du dbyibs ci lta bu ming dang yi ge gang dang gang dgod pa/ rtsa gang dang*/ ji ltar 'khor lo bzhi po de sku gsum gyi ngo bor/ rol par 'gyur/ /de rnams grangs/ dbye ba mi 'tshal zhes dri ba drug go / bas/ / bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / 1mchan 'di dpyid kyi thig le rang du 2 gnas dang dbyibs ston 3 phyi 3 bde chen 4 sprul 'khor spyi bo'i lter son 'khor lo nang*/ ni/ / dbyibs e sprul 'khor gyi nang 'dra/ bde chen gyi phyi 'dra/ yi dbyibs su yang dag gnas/ / gnas snying dang mgrin par yang dag gnas/ / pa'i 'khor lo gnyis/ dbyibs waṃ gi rnam pa lta bur brjod/ / grangs ston lte ba'i gnas/ nang gnas spyi ming*/ pad+ma ni/ / grangs 'dab spyod pa bas nang brgyad/ phyi rol lnga bcu drug ma dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhir ldan/ /'dam skyes 'dab ma chu tshod/ sum cu gnyis/ /spyi bo'i nang du rnam par gnas/ /mgrin pa'i nang du son pa yang*/

/pad+ma lo ma 'pho ba/ bcu drug nyid/ /de bzhin du yang snying nyid la/ /pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa/ brgyad du brjod// ming ston 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi nyid/ / zin ma zin gyi sprul pa 'i 'khor lo/ la ni rab tu grags | | pad+ma chen po 'dab brgyad par/ /chos kyi 'khor lo/ sku ni chos kun 'byung bar| rabatu bskor/ / ro drug la longs spyod rdzogs pa 'i sku/ bcu drug rtsibs/ /de bzhin spyi bo/ 'dab ma sum cu gnyis/ /bde chen gyi rten yin pas/ ye shes chen po 'i rten yin pas de skad ces bya/ la/ /kun tu yang dag rnam par gnas/ / 'di tsaṇ+ḍā lī nyer gcig pa sprul 'di rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bco lnga pa dang cha/ pa'i 'khor lo'i yi ge gang dang gang dgod pa| dbus kyi aṃ la/ su ni/ / nang skor rtsa brgyad la sde tshan brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ / aṃ de yig 'bru dang po'i ngo bo yis/ /'di ni a ste sde tshan brgyad kyi yi ge thams cad bskyed pas| yi ge mchog / snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor rnam bshad pa/ /hūm̐ ni gtum mo'i me dang thag ring bas/ mi shigs pa ru brjod/ / sgra dbyangs lnga bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ dang ni yang dag ldan/ / mtshams su ya ra la was rnam par brgyan/ / mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i nang gnas pa/ /oṃ ni thams cad mgo 'dren/ yig 'bru gsal bar byed/ /cha ni rnam pa bzhi i u e o/ rnams kyis/ / phyi 'dab ma bcu gnyis la dbyangs ma ning dang bral ba yod zer te/ gsal ba med gsung ngo kun tu yongs su bskor ba'o/ / spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo chen tsaṇ+ḍā li nyer gcig pa yang bstan/ de rnams la dmigs te steng rlung gnon pa/ po la/ /haṃ ni thig le'i 'dab ma rnams la ā li bcu drug phrag gnyis/ gzugs can no/ / 1rtsa gnyis ji ltar gnas tshul/ 2 'khor lo bzhi'i/ g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos dag la/ / rtsa gang dang rol pa ston| zla rkyang*/ ba ro/ nyi mar shes rab dang thabs kyi ngo bo yin pa'am khu khrag 'babs pas/

rnam par bshad/ /mgrin pa nas brtsams nas rtsa gsum du gyes/ g.yon pa'i rtsa/ / bde ba la/ rtsa de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can ma/ /lte la thug par gnas pa'ang ngal bso/ ba la kha gtad pa/ 'i nang du ngal bsos shing*/ lam du bas tsam na kha ni 'og tu bltas nas khu ba/ myos byed tha mal pa tsa na dri chu/ 'bab/ /gang zhig lte ba kha las steng du bltas pa'i/ rtsa/ / ro ma/ de bzhin kha ni steng du bltas nas rak+ta/ 'bab/ / kha gtad mgrin pa'i nang du ngal bsos shing*/ / gsum du bskor/ khrag 'bab par ni yang dag bshad | | khu ba la myos byed zla ba zhes byar bshad/ khrag ni nyi ma zhes su gsungs | | rtsa sgo gnyis mnyam par zhon nas ni/ / rdo rje bum pa'i bar 'og rkyang*/ dang ro steng bde chen/ du ring thung*/ mnyam gnas pa/ /'di dag zla ba nyid ma gnyis/ / 'khor lo bzhi la dbang byed pas rtsa ni gnyis su rab tu grags/ / rlung dpa' bo ste mgon po'i rlung*/ rnams dang spyan sogs/ mkha' 'gro ma'i/ / rlung*/rlung gnyis phyir 'gro ba dang ni nang du/ 'ong ba'i rgyu/ / rtsa gnyis gnas/ nang du nub pa dang ni phyir/ 'char ba nyid/ / nang du log dang phyir/ sad pa lta bur gsungs/ /g.yon la la na/ dang g.yas pa'i ra sa na/ nang ngos la ni/ /dbyangs ni ṛ ṝṃ l̥ l̥̄ bsnan pas bcu drug bcu gnyis yang dag gnas/ / bcu gnyis po de kha kā li gnyis gnyis kyi nang na ā li re re mgo gyen la bstan nas gnas/ ni steng du yang dag bshad/ / spyi bo'i g.yas nas brtsams nas ka la sogs pa rnams kyis bskor/ ka sogs so bzhi kha ni 'og gi mgo thur la/ ngos su bltas nas/ gnas/ / kā li nyis sbag gi bar du ā li re re lhag par byas nas sbyar ba nyid/ /k+ṣa ni mtshan ma dang rtog pa za bas/ srin po nyid gsungs pa/ / lte ba'i 'og gi char ni rnam par gnas/ / haṃ bde chen du de ltar byas pas sum cu gnyis/ dbang gsum pa'i dus gang tshe ta thā'i shangs bug g.yas pa nas byang sems na ra ra khyer nas 'ongs nas bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs te/

mgrin par nor bu'i/ chags chen gyis/ / zhu bde tha mi dad/ gzugs kyi zla ba mgrin par/ gnas pa de ni/ na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam pa'i sku/ /de tshe lhan skyes la 'de ba longs spyod pas/ longs spyod rdzogs par bshad// thabs kyi gang tshe rdo rje'i rtser snying kha na/ gnas pa/ /de 'i/ tshe shes rab kyi/ de ni sna rtse thig le ltung ba/ ra lhan skyes/ ro/ / bha gar ltung ba'i dus gang tshe sngar gyi bde ba la/ longs spyod rdzogs sku bha gar ltung ba'i tshe yang*/ / snying kha nas lte ba sprul 'khor du byon tsa na/ pa pha rol ra ma 'gag nub ste de tsam na dga' bral/ par gnas par 'di rnams tsaṇ+ḍā lī bsgom pa'i dbang du byas nas dpyid thig ltar yang res gsung na 'di yin gsung*/ 'gyur ba na/ / lte ba'i bha ga'i nir tsaka nang du son de yang | | ltung tsam/ thig le'i tshad yungs thig le/ dkar tsam zhes rnam par brjod/ / haṃ bsregs pa'i ngo bo yin pas byang sems de la byed pa'i sgo nas nyi ma zhes bya nyi snying khar phyin tsa na mchog dga'| ma'i bde ba mi rtog pa'i/ gzugs gtum mo'i mes thig le dmar por song*/ su yang dag phyag rgya'i si h+la dang 'dres par/ bshad/ / 1lte bar myong bas gnas las ming 2pu tri sprul cing bskyed 3bu tsha'i lus 4dga' ba bzhi las dga' bral sprul pa'i skur ni brjod pa ste/ / des lus thams cad la khyab tsa na lhan skyes te dpe sangs bdud rtsi lnga/ rgyas bu tsha'i phung po lnga/ dbang po drug gi dwangs ma byang chub sems dpa' yi/ / lhan skyes spros bde ba'i ye shes/ pa dngos grub/ skye mched drug po de yis thig le ltung ba/ bskyed pa'o/ / thig le de'i gang bskyed ce na pad+ma thig le dbu ma byang sems| gar dbang thabs/ rgyal po 'i/ ni/ / srid lagathig le las pad gsang gnas su sleb pa| ma thabs kyi srin lag gis gsang rtsa/ bha ga'i kha 'byed pa'i rtsa thams cad la khyab par/ sbyor ba thabs shes so/

'o/ / 1des bu tsha'i lus 2bu tsha'i gzugs bskyed pas 3ye shes sprul pa'i sku yi gzugs su ni/ / thig le ltung bas der haṃ gi byang sems 'dres/ ni khyab tsam na/ nyi ma lte ba nas 'og tu song bas/ nub ltung*/ pa na/ / chos sku bstan pa ni gang yas 'bab kyi lhan skyes/ tshe rdzogs pa'i bu tsha'i bar do'i sems dang thig le/ byang chub sems/ / 1khu khrag gnyis med dam 2khu khrag dang sems 'dres 3gsang ba'i rim pa 4pha ma'i byang sems dang bu tsha'i sems 'dres pa'i mi rtog pa chos sku 5byang sems dang rlung ro gcig pa gong bur gyur pa zla ba lngar brgyal ba rtog med chos sku'o| | rnyog rlung gis ma bskyod pa'i dus/ pa med/ / bde gsal mi rtog pa dang ldan pas/ de nas 'khor ba las grol/ ba'i lam rtog med/ ni rtog pa med pas/ rnam gcad pa'i/ / tha mal gyi spros de'i dus su nyon mongs glo bur ba dang bral bas gsung*/ pa nyer zhi dge ba ste/ / zung 'jug gnyis bde gsal bcu gsum pa dang mnyam pas gzugs sku rang bzhin gyis grub pas gsung*/ med mchog tu dag pa nyid/ / pha ma'i khu khrag gnyis 'dres pa dpal khu khrag sems dang 'dres pa'i tshul| ldan rdo rje sems bde stong*/ dpa'i gzugs/ / rang bzhin yi ge bzhi ldan de nyid rgyu'i rgyud yin pas gsung shrī ni he ru ka zhes bshad/ / tan tra gnyis rgyud de lta bu'i lhan skyes de gnyis med la brten pas/ ni srin bu'i gzugs can nyid/ / de'ang dga' ba gsum rgod dang lta de tsam na'i nyams myong de la/ ba lag bcang nyid/ / yang ste lhan skyes de nyid mngon du byed pa/ rgyud du lhan skyes de gnyis med la brten pas/ de nyid rnam par gnas/ pa'i 'bras bu yang 'di yin gsung*/ dga' ba dang mchog dga' 'dod chags nyid dang dga' bral/ chags bral stong pa/ yang yang*/ / sa ha dza/ rtog pa zos nas lam du shes na srin bu yon tan/ gnas lhan skyes nyid 'phel bar byed/

pa rlung dhū tīr gnas pas ye shes gnas so/ / nyid/ / lus kyi dkyil 'khor la rtsa dang dkyil 'khor gnas rtsa ni thams cad sku gsum sogs thams cad nang du/ mnyam par/ sbyor ba'i || mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba sdom/ /drug pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// // rgyud thams cad kyi phyag rgya bsdus pa'i le'u'i don gsal bar bstan de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma la sogs pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ / gzhal yas khang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam thabs| dang ni/ / de'i nang du lha rnams bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs/ ji ltar

bskyed pa'i tshul| 'byung ba rigs lnga po la sogs pa/ dang*/ / ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsum par/ 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang du ji ltar dgod pa/ khyad par dang*/ / lus kyi brda/ ngag gi brda/ yid kyi brda dgongs pa'i skad kyi khyad par ni/ / bzhi par/ bskyed rim gyi spros pa sogs bcom ldan 'das kyis sngar gsungs na/ / nang gi sdom sdom pa'i rab tu byed pa'ang bshad par bya ste de'i don gsal bar byed/ pa'ang bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshon par zad/ rnal 'byor pa'ang bzung*/ lus kyi/ dbus lte ba na/ gnas pa 'i/ ra/ / 1dbu ma'i ma sna shad lta bu 2yi ge ni am̐ gi rnam pa mahā su kha/ sdom pa'i gnas/ /ji ltar phyi rol tu rang bzhin dang*/ bcas pa sdom pa ltar/ de bzhin nang*/ du'ang rtog pa/ /gang du sdom pa/ gang gis sdom pa/ gang sdom pa sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu phye/ / 'o na sdom pa ni gling gzhi'i le'ur thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa gsung*/ thabs shes sbyor bas sdom pa yin na 'dir thabs shes gang zhe na bo la a wa dhū tī srub pa/ 'i bde ba de/ phyag rgya 'o/ che/ / phyi rol gyi phyag rgya'i lam spang pa'i phyir/ rdo rje skye mched de'i nang na mo'i bdud rtsi lnga thabs/ thabs aṃ du bde ba skye zhing mched pas/ bdag nyid/ / rten dang brten pa tha mi dad 'dis ni nang gi gsang ba'i lte ba'i e waṃ ngaṃ cha ngam ཾ aṃ thabs shes rab yin pas/ snyoms 'jug pas/ / le'u gsum pa gleng gzhi'i le'u ltar phyi rol gnyis gnyis bstan pa med/ / chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*| sprul pa ni sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs kyi don gsal bar bstan sku gsum 'khor lo gsum na mo'i khu ba bde chen 'khor lo nas 'byung bar gcig pas de'i rten bde chen 'khor lo'i 'og ma gsum dang tha mi dad par bstan/ lus yod pa de/ kyi nang du ni/ / gsum gyi 'khor lo'i gzugs kyis brjod par bya/

/sku gsum dbyer med du/ yongs su shes pa las/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor brjod/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang*/ /de bzhin bde ba chen po nyid/ / gnas skye gnas snying mgrin dbus su ni/ /sku gsum po ni rnam par gnas | | nges tshig ston ma 'dod khams pa/ lus pa yi sems can gyis/ / rang bzhin gyi sems can la gnas pa ston/ skye ba 'i gzhi/ gang la sprul 'khor/ brjod bya ba/ /gang zhig sprul pas bu tsha bskyed pa'i/ gnas brtan phyir/ /de la sprul pa'i sku nyid yin/ /sems ni tshogs kyi rang bzhin te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo snying khar yin/ /ro rnams drug gi gzugs can gyi/ /bza' ba la/ nges par longs spyod brjod/ / yang na chos kyi 'khor lo bstan chos rnams kun sems can gyi ston pa'am/ de las 'byung bas/ la brtan pa'i phyir/ / chos 'khor thams cad yod pa'i rang bzhin can/ / sems mgrin par longs spyod 'khor lo dang*/ /bde ba chen po 'i rten thig le phal che/ spyi bor gnas/ /e waṃ rnam pa ji ltar byas pas 'bras bu 'byung bas/ rgyu mthun nyid/ / rgyu 'bras mi 'dra bar bstan pa smin pas rnam smin chos kyi 'khor lo las/ /skyes bu 'i 'du bya ba'i khyad par las 'byung bas/ byed pa'ang longs longs spyod skyes bu byed pa nyid/ zer spyod la/ /bde ba'i 'khor lor rnam par rtog pa'i/ dri med nyid/ /rgyu mthun la sogs rnam dbye bas/ /'bras bu rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ / lam gyi dbang du byas pa'i 'khor lo bzhi ston las ci'i phyir rgyu mthun kyi 'bras bu| kyi bshang lam 'byed 'dzum/ rlung gis sum mdo'ime/ bskul ba yis/ / bde ba'i las kyi 'bras bu/ la bcom ldan 'das/ shes rab spyod/ / tsaṇ+ḍā lī nyer gcig pa bstan/ sprul 'khor gang phyir thabs kyis zin na myang 'das/ ma zin na bu tsha sogs/ sprul pa 'i tsakra de ni bu tsha la sogs pa 'khor ba bskyed pa'i/ gnas brtan phyir/

/sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas brtan nyid// chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang du dhū tī'i cha shas gnas pa de las chos thams cad 'byung bas chos smra ba ni bha ga te sgra yin la de las thams cad 'byung*/ byang sems phal cher 'dus pas ni kā ya/ kaṃ ni ngag las byung ba'i phyir/ / chos kyi 'khor lor thams cad yod par smra/ /gang zhig mgrin saṃ bhe ḍa/ par ro drug po kun gyis bkur ba'i phyir/ kun rig phyir/ /longs spyod 'khor lor kun saṃ bhe ḍa/ bkur nyid/ /gang zhig bde chen gyi khu ba phal cher/ mgor gnas byang sems phal cher 'dus pas ni kā ya kaṃ phyir/ /bde chen 'khor lor dge 'dun che/ / rang bzhin gyi sde shāka thub sngon lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ bltams pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba la sogs pa dang*/ 'khor sde pa bzhi yod na 'dir yang sde bzhi/ de'i gtso bo sems can/ dang*/ lhums dang*/ bltams pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba la sogs pa gang zhe na lan dkyus/ pa bzhi ni/ sku zhes brjod pa phyag rgya bsdus pa'i/ ste | | lto ba gnas su brjod par bya/ /skye gnas nas byung ba tsam la skye gnas la/ 'dod chags bral ba yin/ / ma'i mngal gyi phru ma chos gos te/ /de bzhin bskyed mkhan/ ma ni mkhan mo pha slob dpon/ nyid/ /mgo bor thal mo sbyar ba phyag / btsas tsam na khrus byed pa la sogs pa 'gro ba'i bya ba khrims kyi gnas/ /de rgyud du/ skye gnas kyi ni rnam pa a/ /de bzhin bde chen rnam pa haṃ/ /zhes 'byung*/ bzhin sngags bzlas pa dang kha thon/ a dang haṃ/ / rang bzhin gyi snga gas 'don skyes pa dge slong nyid/ /gcer bu ra byung ba ni/ skra dang kha spu pa la sogs pa yod pa dang mthun pas bregs/ pa'i dod do/ / 'di rnams gang la the tshom skyes pa/ rkyen gyis sems can rnams/ / rang bzhin gyi sangs lus rdzogs pa dang sems rdzogs pa'i/ rgyas nyid du cha thun mong ba/ the tshom med/ / mngal du zla ba bcu gnas pa/ yang sa bcu po/

rnams te | | zla ba bcu lon nas skyes pa'i sems can ni/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste sangs rgyas so// go | 1gleng gzhi'i le'u'i don bstan 2bzhugs pa'i gnas 3de lta bu de lus dkyil la dgongs na byang sems dang bha ga la'ang zhes pa'i don yin na snyam brtag par bya/ btsun mo'i bha nang gi rang bzhin lhun grub gyi sangs rgyas bstan/ ga bde chen du/ khu ston pa bcom ldan 'das ni/ ba zhes bya'i rnam par gnas/ / dngos grub gtan la dbab pa'i don gsal bar byed de med pas ni bde med 'gyur/ /bde ba spangs na de med 'gyur/ / gcig med par gnas pa'i nus pa med phyir gcig la gcig ltos pa/ dang bcas/ / pa de bzhin du / de'i rten lha yi rnal 'byor la gnas te snyoms par zhugs pa/ las bde skyes pa de zhen pa med pa ba/ / lus kyi sangs rgyas gsal 'debs pa/bde gsal mi rtog pa de phyir rang bzhin gyi/ sangs rgyas sems can/ dngos po min// de nyid lhar snang bas/ dngos med tshul yang na zhu ba/ yang min/ / rgyas zhal ci'i phyir sems can la/ phyag rnam pas 'i/ gzugs yo da pa'i/ can dang*/ / sems can rang bzhin gyi rtog pa dang bral bas mchog tu bde ba gzugs med pa/ /de phyir 'gro kun kyi rgyud la gzugs sku dang chos sku gnyis/ lhan cig skyes/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin gyi lhan skyes/ brjod | | rang bzhin gyi sgrib pa'i dri ma las rnam dag rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni mya ngan 'das/ /zhal phyag kha dog dbyibs las ni/ /lha yi gzugs kyi rnal 'byor gyi/ /skyes pa tsam gyis lha'i skur/ rnam par gnas/ / lus lha sems sangs rgyas yin na ci ste de ltar ma rtogs she na 'on kyang bag chags glo bur ba/ phal pas bsgribs pas ma rtogs/ so/ /de skad lha mos bshad pa ni/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi gong na med | pa'i rgyud don yin/ le'u bzhi pa'i don yin the tshom ji lta bu skyes pa

de gang la the tshom na rang bzhin la the tshom mi rigs te/ rang bzhin gyi dag pa gong du ma bshad la/ sku gsum la sogs pa bshad pa de ni rang bzhin ma yin te yin na mngal gyi phru ma chos gos su ji ltar 'gyur/ lam la za bar mi rigs te/ lam thabs mang ba'i phyir snyam pa la/ lam la za ste/ lam de ltar rang la yod na ci'i phyir ma grol/ yang na rgyu med pa 'am/ yang na lam ma yin zhes dgongs pa'o/ /de la rgyu yod pa dang lam yin par ston no// nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med la sogs pa lha mo thams cad la 'di lta ste/ sa dag pa spyan dang*/ chu mā ma kī dang*/ me gos dkar mo dang*/ rlung sgrol ma dang*/ khro gnyer can dang*/ skul byed ma dang*/ ri khrod ma shing lo can dang*/ 'og zhal ma dang | sdom pa ma dang*/ de dag la sogs pa ri rab kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams sems can sangs rgyas yin byas pa la/ mchog tu ngo mtshar bar gyur cing brgyal ba dang*/ skrag par gyur to/ / rtsa rgyud na med/ de zhu ba'i tshig kha bskang*/ nas mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi tshogs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bslang du gsol | | brgyal ba las bslang ba de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rnal 'byor ma thams cad bslang ba'i phyir 'di skad ces bka' stsal/ rang bzhin dang chos mthun gyi sems can rnams ni lus sems gnyis ka sangs rgyas nyid/ / rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas yin yang glo bur du bsgribs pa mi 'gal ba 'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgribs/ pas sems can yin la/ /de bsal bas ni rtogs pa'i/ sangs rgyas nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das de de bzhin no/ / dngos grub gtan la dbab pa'i don rigs kyi bu/ de bsal ba'i thabs gang zhig dug gi de kho na nyid/ mi shes 'jig rten pa/

/btsan dug zos pas brgyal ba'am 'chi/ bar 'gyur/ / dug gi de kho na la rmongs pa/ spangs pa'i/ de nyid kho na/ yid kyis shes pa de/ ni/ / dug de yi mi 'chi bar byed pa/ de nyid yongs su gcod/ /dug gis dum bu gang nyid kyi/ /skyai bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ / gnas pa'i dug gi de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gis 'gro ba'i/ dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ji ltar rlung gis zin de la/ /ma sha'i bza' ba sbyin par bya/ /bzlog pa'i sman ni btags pa las/ / sbos pa'i rlung gis sran tshod kyi/ rlung ni bsnun par byed/ / lhar so sor rtog las tha mal pa'i/ rnam rtog dang*/ / lha'i srid pa nyid kyis tha mal pa'i/ srid dag byed/ / spam pa ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/ /de bzhin dngos po'i tha mal pa/ rnam rtog kyang*/ / lha'i rnam pas nges par sbyangs bar bya/ / rigs 'dra/ ji ltar 'tshed pas tshig pa yang*/ /yang ni me yis gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin tha mal pa'i/ 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ / thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i 'dod chags mes ni gdung bar bya/ / zhen pas 'dod pa la spyad pa skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ / gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur pa/ /thabs 'du shes gsum/ dang bcas na lha dang rang rig sems nyid du shes pa'i/ de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// thabs kyis ma zin na 'dod chags kyis ni 'jig rten 'ching*/ / zin na 'dod chags kyis ni rnal grol 'gyur/ / 1phar phyin las bzlog bsten pa/ pa'i bsgom pa 'di nyid ni/ / sangs rgyas mu stegs nyan thos/ kyis mi shes/ / 1byang sems sra ba la sogs pa 2 go bzlog pa ste bsten pa dang thabs su 'gyur ram snyam na 3byang sems 'byung lnga rigs lnga/ thabs shes/ he badz+ra yab yum/ bol+la dang kak+ko la/ rdor pad do/ /bsam pa mahā su kha mngon du bya ba'i bsam pas sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pas thabs su 'gyur 'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin las/

/kun tu ru la bde ba nam mkha' dang/ lnga ru 'gyur/ / zhu bde tha mi dad kyi dga' ba chen po lhan skyes/ gcig pu nyid | | nang tshan gyi dbye bas lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ / nir de sha bol+la kak+ko la sbyor bas | | de spyan ma yin pas de yab dang tha mi dad pa reg pa sra ba'i bag chags nyid/ /sra ba ni sa yin la sa rnam par dag pa rnam snang gsung 'gre nyon mongs pa las gti mug chos kyi phyir | | gti mug rnam par snang mdzad du shes pas lam du 'gyur/ des 'gre brjod/ / gang phyir byang sems gsher ba nyid/ /gsher ba chu yi khams de mā ma kī yin la de yab dang tha mi dad pa/ su brjod/ /chu ni mi bskyod ngo bo'i phyir/ /zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa/ /gnyis kyi bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /rtag tu drod ni skye bar 'gyur// de gos dkar mo yin la de 'dod chags dpag med rdo rje yin/ /'dod chags drod las yang dag byung*/ /kak+ko lar las rak+ta 'byung ba de las 'dod chags/ ni gang zhig gi rlung| sems/ / 1byang sems 2'phul bar byed pas/ de ni sgrol ma yin la de/ rlung gi rang bzhin can/ /don yod rlung las byung ba'i phyir/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yin | | su kha chags par bya ba yin pas bde ba 'dod chags sems yin te/ / rat+na rin chen khrag dag khrag dang 'dod chags nyid/ /ser sna rnam par dag pa/ nam mkha' las byung ba/ / bde ba mi rtog pa nam mkha' ser sna rdo rje yin/ / spyir sems ni chen po zhu bde tha mi dad/ gcig nyid la/ / bye brag lnga yi gzugs kyis mtshon pa nyid/ /rigs ni lnga po'i skyes pa la/ /de rang las phye bas/ la stong phrag du ma nyid/ / yin/ de phyir 'di dag bde ba chen por/ rang bzhin gcig / te ka bde chen mchog tu phan pa nyid/ / yin| 'dod chags me sogs sems lnga yis/ /dbye bas lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ / gaṅgā'i klung ni bcu yi bye ma snyed/ /rigs gcig la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs

| | rigs lnga/ nang tshan gyi dbye bas rin chen la ni rigs ni du ma rnams/ /de rnams rigs la brgya phrag du ma rnams/ /de rnams la yang 'bum phrag rigs chen rnams/ /bye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur/ /de la rigs la grangs med rigs rnams nyid/ /mchog de thams cad bde ba chen po rigs gcig tu dga' ba'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ / des na sangs rgyas grangs med bsgom pas sel ba'i thabs su 'thad do/ / zhes bka' bstsal to/ /'dir gsol ba/ bdud rtsi lnga'i thig le gcig la ci gong bu'i gzugs can 'di tsam du'ang chung ba de snyed kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ci lags/ na de las rigs du ma 'byung ba 'gal lo zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / bha la pa tha ni bye ma'i lam mam/ skra'i khyon las/ 'dir skra'i khyon gyi skabs yin no/ / bye ma'i de nyid rnal 'byor pas lam du byed pas/

lam 'bru gu dang 'dra ba/ ni gcig pu thig le/ la/ / 1yon tan gyi ldog pas 2byang sems bdud rtsi lnga rgyal ba lnga'i ngo bo yin pas 3byang sems sa la sogs pa lnga rgyal ba lnga yin pas/ sangs rgyas du ma dog min zhing*/ / thig le gcig kyang sgo dgu las byung ba'i tshogs yin pas de'i bde ba du ma yin/ gcig la gcig bcer ba'am gzir min sgo dgu las byung ba'i/ byang sems stobs bcu mnga' ba ste thig le gcig la'ang du ma bzhugs/ ba'i lha/ / mngon du bya ba bzhengs thig le gcig la du mar/ shig bzhengs shig rang rig bdag gi ni/ / kha snar sdum gnas/ par ston mo bzhes par 'tshal/ / thig le gcig la'ang du mar bzhugs pa'i rdzu sbor/sbyor 'phrul stobs kyis rigs kyi bu/ / mi 'gal lo/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la brten te gtum mo sbar ba las/ yang gsang ba'i rim pa/ dag sbyor/ 'byung ba rang byin gyis rlabs pa'i ye shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bka' stsal pa/ / 'khor lo bzhi la yang rtsa gnyis nas/ dag sbyor byung mtshan nyid ni/ / gtum mo me'i ye shes/ la gu saṃ bha ra'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar te bshad don dam byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ par bya yis lha mo nyon/ / gsang ba'i rim pa zer gsang rlung dbu mar sbyor gsung*/ ba la ni sa rlung*/ yi khams/ / sprul 'khor/ mchog la de bzhin du ni chos 'khor chu/ / 'i rlung*/ dges pa la ni me 'i rlung*/ ru bshad/ / longs spyod/ thams cad bdag nyid rlung gi rlung*/ la gnas/ / bde chen/ rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa ni/ / bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma sangs de lta bu'i 'khor lo bzhir gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa ni/ rgyas kun rlung bzhi po rtsar sdom gsung*/ gyi sdom pa su kha/ bdag / gsang ba la sogs pa dang sbyar yang na de lta bu'i ye shes de nyid kyi rnam sku dang ye shes dbu mar sdom gsung*/ par snang bas| me long lta bu'i tshul/ / mchog te bzhin du yang mi mnyam pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang bral bas|
